negative cases-not just the happy path.

- Follow disciplined engineering practices around coding standards, Git workflows, branching, pull

requests, and clean commit history .

- Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and support the systems you build in production.

- Participate in incident response, debugging, root-cause analysis, and preventive improvements.

- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, deployment automation, and release-

process improvements . - Maintain technical documentation covering APIs, database/schema decisions, configuration,

operational procedures, and runbooks .

- Work directly with non-technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and communicate technical

constraints, risks, and trade-offs in a clear and actionable manner.

- 3+ years of experience building and shipping production-grade web applications as a full-stack engineer.

- API versioning

- Request validation

- Error handling and error contracts

- API documentation

- Component-based development

- Responsive interfaces

- Comfortable deploying, monitoring, debugging, and troubleshooting applications on AWS or GCP.

Good to Have

Experience in one or more of the following will be an advantage:

- Building multi-tenant SaaS applications, including tenant isolation and data-access controls.

- Event-driven architecture , Kafka, message queues, and asynchronous processing.

- Integrating payment gateways, logistics platforms, courier services, or other third-party APIs.

- Building reporting, analytics, or data-intensive dashboards. - Integrating LLM/AI-powered capabilities into production applications.

- Experience working on systems involving complex workflows, approvals, permissions, or transactional

data .

What We Look For

We value engineers who:

- Take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

- Think about the business problem, not just the technical implementation.

- Ask questions when requirements are unclear.

- Identify edge cases before they become production issues.

- Care about data correctness and system reliability.

- Can make pragmatic technical decisions and explain their trade-offs.

- Write maintainable code that other engineers can understand and extend.

- Are comfortable working across the frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure.

- Treat testing, documentation, monitoring, and production support as part of engineering-not as

afterthoughts.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled QA Engineer (Manual + Automation) to join the engineering team at Softobiz supporting the Pickles web transformation project. You will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies that span manual, automation, API, regression, and release validation testing across the platform.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with both manual testing practices and modern test automation frameworks, with a solid understanding of CI/CD integration, API testing, and end-to-end quality assurance across web applications. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure the highest levels of product quality and a reliable, release-ready codebase throughout the development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Manual Testing

  • Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing of web applications.
  • Perform cross-browser and cross-device compatibility testing to ensure consistent user experiences.
  • Conduct end-to-end manual validation of user stories and acceptance criteria, working closely with product and design stakeholders.
  • Identify, document, and track defects using issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira), ensuring clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and timely resolution.
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure quality is built into every stage of the process.

Automation Testing

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or equivalent.
  • Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automated test scripts in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) to enable continuous testing on every build.
  • Monitor and analyse automated test results, investigate flaky tests, and maintain a high level of automation coverage across critical user journeys.
  • Contribute to test strategy discussions and advocate for automation-first approaches where appropriate.

API Testing

  • Design and execute comprehensive API test suites for RESTful services using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent.
  • Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication flows, and error handling across API contracts.
  • Collaborate with backend developers to review API specifications and flag potential issues before implementation.
  • Automate API test collections and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous API quality validation.

Regression Testing

  • Own and maintain the regression test suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of core platform functionality.
  • Execute full and targeted regression cycles ahead of each release, clearly documenting scope, results, and sign-off status.
  • Identify areas of the application most susceptible to regression risk and prioritise automation coverage accordingly.
  • Track and report regression metrics over time to support continuous quality improvement.

Release Validation

  • Act as the quality gate for each release, coordinating release validation activities across environments (dev, staging, production).
  • Prepare and execute release checklists, smoke tests, and sanity checks to confirm production readiness.
  • Work with DevOps and engineering leads to validate deployments and sign off on go-live readiness.
  • Document release test outcomes and communicate clearly to stakeholders on quality status and any outstanding risks.

Quality Engineering & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and designers to define acceptance criteria and establish a shared definition of done.
  • Champion a quality-first culture within the team through proactive defect prevention, shift-left testing practices, and continuous feedback.
  • Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices.
  • Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA best practices and internal knowledge sharing.

Required Technical Skills

  • Manual Testing: Test case design, exploratory testing, UAT, regression, cross-browser testing
  • Automation Framework: Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; Page Object Model (POM); reusable test architecture
  • Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript
  • API Testing: Postman, RestAssured or equivalent; REST API validation, contract testing
  • CI/CD Integration: GitHub Actions or equivalent; integrating test suites into build pipelines
  • Defect Management: Jira or equivalent; defect lifecycle, severity classification, reporting
  • Test Management: TestRail, Zephyr, or equivalent; test plans, traceability matrices, test reporting
  • Regression Testing: Regression suite ownership, coverage strategy, scheduled regression cycles
  • Release Validation: Release checklists, smoke/sanity testing, environment validation, go-live sign-off

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4-7 years of hands-on QA experience covering both manual and automation testing in production web application environments.
  • Demonstrable experience building and maintaining automation frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman or equivalent - this is a mandatory requirement.
  • Proven ownership of regression test suites and release validation activities in an agile delivery context.
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams - ideally in a global or client-facing delivery environment.

title: Mainframe Batch & Console Operations Professional
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Computer Operators at Kyndryl are key in helping revolutionize the way we operate complex computer systems. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, supervise and control intricate networks and applications, and operate distributed systems in a multi-vendor environment.

As a Computer Operator you will be on the technical frontline - performing batch operations as per service agreements, analyzing first-level issues across systems, and resolving/routing issues as appropriate. You will also have the opportunity to develop support system management processes specific to customer requirements, ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve JCL abends, override issues, and symbolic parameter problems.
  • Allocate and manage BIOS, TIF, GDG, and VSAM datasets.
  • Identify ownership of Production and QA jobs and coordinate with appropriate development groups.
  • Perform file out-of-space (FOOS) recovery and support batch/online recovery activities.
  • Coordinate batch job restarts, abend recovery, and customer escalations.
  • Utilize break-glass procedures for emergency production support access when required.
  • Monitor and manage OPC/TWS job scheduling activities including hold/release actions, predecessor/successor analysis, and database lookups.
  • Support NDM/Connect: Direct operations including process monitoring, troubleshooting transfer failures, DR transfers, and client file transfers.
  • Perform PDX activities including installs, promotes, backouts, and password reset support using Power IDs.
  • Manage ITSM incidents, problem tickets, FACHA/Hot Item creation, ticket reassignment, and closure activities.
  • Process TSSR work orders, manage production/QA job requests, and respond to operational emails within SLA timelines.
  • Execute weekend IPL support activities, validate environment availability, and coordinate fixes for out-of-sequence abends.
  • Ensure Production, QA, and Test regions are operational following maintenance and IPL activities.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 4 to 5 years of experience in Mainframe Batch & Console Operations.
  • Strong experience in Mainframe Production Support, including:
    • JCL troubleshooting and abend resolution
    • OPC/TWS scheduling
    • NDM / Connect:Direct
    • VSAM, GDG, DB2, and TSO/ISPF dataset management
    • PDX deployment support
    • ITSM ticket management
    • Batch monitoring and recovery
    • Incident and problem management
    • IPL support activities
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Experience with job scheduling tools, reporting, and logging systems.
  • Proficiency in Windows and Mac operating systems.
  • Experience in troubleshooting, backup and recovery, and basic networking concepts.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Ability to work in a 24x7 production support environment.
  • Experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and service restoration activities.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

  • Hands-on production experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or equivalent) not experimental or personal-project only.

Seeking a highly skilled Power BI and ServiceNow Reporting SME responsible for designing, developing, automating, and governing enterprise operational dashboards and analytics solutions. Power BI Dashboard Development

Build and maintain ServiceNow dashboards, scheduled reports, and analytics views
Support reporting across Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request, CMDB, Compliance, and Operational governance areas

Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and governance compliance

Work across reporting data flow including: ServiceNow Snowflake SQL Power BI Power Automate Excel

Support Snowflake-based reporting integrations and analytics pipelines
Ensure reporting performance, refresh stability, and data integrity
Preferred understanding of:
ETL concepts
Data modeling
Relational data structures
Data optimization techniques
Advanced level of Excel knowledge
Automation & Process Optimization
Develop automation solutions using Power Automate
Automate report generation, scheduling, approvals, notifications, and operational workflows
Identify manual operational activities suitable for automation
Drive reporting standardization and reusable dashboard frameworks
Research and implement new automation opportunities continuously
Support AI-driven reporting enhancements and intelligent analytics
Governance, Quality & Reporting Standards
Validate dashboards before deployment
Ensure proper stakeholder walkthrough, testing, and sign-off
Monitor dashboard refreshes, failures, and data inconsistencies proactively
Maintain documentation for: Dashboards Data sources Queries Automation flows Access governance Reporting logic
Ensure all reporting solutions follow governance and quality standards
Maintain strong reporting hygiene and operational ownership
Stakeholder Collaboration & Analytical Consulting
Work directly with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements deeply
Conduct operational analysis and convert business problems into reporting solutions
Provide analytical insights, trend analysis, and governance recommendations
Collaborate with operations teams, tower leads, governance teams, and leadership
Handle ad hoc reporting and executive dashboard requests independently

Key Deliverables Expected
Candidate should be capable of independent delivery:
Operational governance dashboards
SLA and compliance dashboards
Executive summary dashboards
Incident / Problem / Change analytics
Trend and backlog analysis
Operational stability dashboards
Infrastructure and network analytics
Audit and quality reporting
Automation-enabled reporting workflows
Cross-platform integrated reporting solutions
Technical Skills ?? Mandatory
Strong hands-on experience in Power BI
Strong Power Query, and dashboard design skills
Strong working experience with ServiceNow reporting and analytics
Experience in dashboard optimization and data visualization best practices
Experience handling complex operational datasets
Experience with Power Automate
Preferred Skills
Snowflake reporting integration knowledge
Power BI Certification (PL-300 preferred)
ServiceNow reporting or platform analytics certifications
ITIL knowledge
Experience in Infrastructure / ITSM reporting environments
Understanding of AI-enabled analytics and automation models
AI & Future Operating Model Readiness
The role requires adaptability toward AI-driven reporting and analytics operations.
Candidate should demonstrate:
Ability to work in AI-assisted operational environments
Interest in Agentic AI-driven analytics models
Understanding of intelligent reporting automation
Willingness to adopt AI Copilot-enabled reporting workflows
Ability to identify opportunities for AI-driven operational insights and efficiency improvements

What We Are Specifically Looking For
Someone who understands reporting beyond visualization
Someone who focuses on operational outcomes, not just dashboard creation
Someone who can independently convert operational pain points into analytics solutions
Someone who can challenge unclear reporting requirements
Someone who understands governance, compliance, SLA, and operational reporting deeply
Someone who can simplify complex operational data into actionable insights
Someone who can automate repetitive reporting activities
Someone who can work across technical and business teams confidently
Someone who takes ownership of reporting quality and operational impact

Important Note
This role is not a report-generation support role. This role requires a strong reporting and analytics professional capable of driving operational decisions, governance visibility, automation, and measurable business value through enterprise reporting solutions.

title: Product Engineer
jobDescription:
THE COMPANY
Careerminds is a leader in career transition and coaching solutions, helping organizations support employees through change while enabling workforce growth and development. Our product portfolio includes market-leading Career Transition and Coaching Services as well as Progression, our application for Career Frameworks and progression planning.
THE ROLE
We are looking for an Product Engineer who owns products end to end - from problem to production to the metric that proves it worked - using AI as a force multiplier, not a novelty
This role exists because of how we build: a small product strategy team sets direction and priorities, and engineers own the work end to end - discovery, design, build, ship, and the result. You ll have the autonomy of a founder inside your domain, and the accountability that comes with it.
We are looking for an engineer who already works with Claude Code and Claude Design and wants to push the ceiling higher - not people who are curious about AI, but people for whom AI-native development is already how they ship.

This is a 100% remote/work-from-home role.
THE KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own the full lifecycle of features and products across our consumer platform (e.g., Career.io, Resume.io and adjacent surfaces) - you are the product owner, designer, and engineer for your domain.
  • Front end to back end to data. You build the UI, the services behind it, and the instrumentation that tells you whether it worked. No throwing work over a wall.
  • Velocity with judgment. You ship continuously and safely, using AI tooling to compress the build loop without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
YOU RE SOMEONE WHO...
  • Is AI-native by default. You already get meaningful leverage from agentic tools (Claude Code, Claude Design, and similar) and treat learning to use them better as part of the craft.
  • Defines success up front in measurable terms , ship to production, watch the numbers, and iterate or kill based on what the data says.
  • Focuses on outcome over output. Lines of code, story points, and shipped tickets are not the goal. Moving the metric is.
  • Has high agency, low ceremony. You don t wait to be told what to build next. You operate with founder-like ownership inside your area.
  • Is Direct. You communicate crisply with strategy, design, and other engineers, and you push back when you think a direction is wrong.
THE MUST-HAVES
  • Proven full-stack ability. You are genuinely comfortable across the stack - modern front end (TypeScript/React or equivalent) through backend services and data - and can ship a feature end to end without a handoff. [Adjust stack specifics to match your team - e.g., TypeScript/React, Node/PHP-Symfony backend, AWS, Kubernetes.]
  • A track record of shipping products end to end , ideally where you owned more than the code - scope, tradeoffs, and results.
  • Demonstrable AI leverage. You can walk us through real work where AI tooling materially multiplied your throughput, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn t.
  • Product judgment. You can take an ambiguous problem, decide what to build, and defend the call. You think about the user and the business, not just the implementation.
  • Data fluency. You can define, instrument, and read your own metrics, and you let evidence change your mind.
  • Speed and quality together. You move fast and leave behind systems you d be happy to maintain.
  • Authorization to work for any US employer.
THE NICE-TO-HAVES
  • Familiarity with our domain (careers, hiring, resumes, marketplaces) or other high-traffic consumer products.
  • Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, IaC) and modern data tooling.
  • A public body of work - shipped products, open source, writing, or side projects that show what you do unprompted.

About the role:

Position Title: Administrator-Corporate Affairs

Corporate Title: Administrator

Location: Bangalore, BCIT park, Thannisandra Main Road

MUFG Legal department in EMEA

The Legal department in Europe, Middle East and Africa (together, EMEA ) provides legal services to and manages the legal risk for MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities (EMEA) and the MUSHD international business (collectively the Firm ). Members of Legal are dual-hatted across MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities. Dual-hat employees will be expected to be entity neutral across all responsibilities to ensure that services are provided to both entities effective and without favour or detriment to the other entity.

The Legal department in EMEA provides legal services to and manages the legal risk for MUFG Bank, Ltd. (branches and subsidiaries in EMEA) and MUFG Securities (EMEA) (collectively the Firm ).

Members of Legal are dual-hatted across MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities. Dual-hat employees will be expected to be entity neutral across all responsibilities to ensure that services are provided to both entities effective and without favour or detriment to the other entity.

The Corporate Affairs Pillar is a team within EMEA Legal and is the team responsible for managing key governance boards and committees.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The individual is part of the Corporate Affairs Pillar within the Legal Department and reports into the Head of Corporate Affairs for the EMEA region, and locally reports to MGS Legal Team Lead (Legal Counsel and Vice President, MGS, Bangalore, India).

Their role includes provision of corporate secretarial and governance support and advice for Board and Board committees (for EMEA Securities and Bank subsidiaries as well as for International subsidiaries). The individual will be responsible for ensuring that company secretarial obligations are executed accurately and on time, in a controlled and well-governed manner in line with MUFG policies, applicable legal and regulatory requirements. The role will work closely with EMEA Legal leadership, Company Secretariat, Independent Non-Executive Directors and a range of business and control function stakeholders, and will operate on an entity-neutral basis across MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Corporate Affairs and Governance

  • Provide day-to-day company secretarial and governance support for Boards, Board Committees and Executive Committees of EMEA Bank and Securities entities.
  • Coordinate Board and Committee meetings, including collation of papers, agendas, actions logs and follow-up.
  • Attendance (via video conference) at and taking minutes and actions of Board and Committee meetings.
  • Provide administrative support to the Head of Corporate Affairs for the EMEA region.
  • Provide support and advice to Independent Non-Executive Directors as required.
  • Prepare, coordinate and submit periodic and ad-hoc statutory and regulatory filings, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Update and maintain EMEA statutory records, constitutional documents and governance documentation.
  • Support the ongoing maintenance and application of the EMEA corporate governance framework, procedures and operating model.
  • Assist with corporate approvals, resolutions and governance actions across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of an integrated governance framework and process for policies for Bank and Securities.
  • Maintain and enhance good working relationships with stakeholders, across the region and globally to share best practices, provide support and develop effective local policies and procedures which are appropriate to the global franchise, and working in support of the One MUFG and overall Group strategy.

WORK EXPERIENCE

  • Solid experience in company secretarial, corporate affairs and governance, or a comparable role within a regulated environment.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Board and Board Committee processes and statutory / regulatory filings.

  • Experience working across multiple legal entities or jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to manage deadlines, prioritize work and operate accurately in a controlled environment.
  • Experience interacting with senior stakeholders, including Directors and Non-Executive Directors.

Preferred:

  • Experience within an in-house legal department in financial services.
  • Exposure to Legal transformation, operating model change or remediation initiatives.
  • Experience working within a dual-hat or multi-entity framework.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

PERFORMANCE AND DUTIES

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to outserve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences, and we are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric values to join our growing team.

Get to Know the Role

The Senior Solution Specialist will report directly to the Delivery Manager for Finance Systems. As a Solution Specialist, Finance Systems, you will work with Grabber Technology Solutions teams and Finance users to understand challenges, current processes and system requirements. You will translate these needs into future-state application requirements, process improvements and solution designs, working with our teams and external implementation partners where required.

You will focus on managing change requests and project implementations within the Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP environment, with an emphasis on Record-to-Report (R2R) processes. Experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) will be an advantage.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Lead Finance Systems change requests and project implementations from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation.
  • Collaborate with Finance partners to understand needs, document all-state processes, standardise requirements and perform fit-gap analysis.
  • Translate requirements into functional solution designs, configuration recommendations, process improvements and implementation plans.
  • Assess the impact, risks, dependencies and priorities of proposed changes across finance processes, data, integrations and related applications.
  • Coordinate System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, test-result validation and business approval.
  • Work with technical teams, Oracle Support, implementation partners and Finance partners to deliver integrations, data migrations, enhancements, releases and quarterly Oracle Fusion Cloud upgrades.
  • Evaluate new Oracle platform capabilities and conduct Proofs of Concept (POCs) to assess feasibility, value and agreement on Finance requirements.
  • Drive change adoption through process documentation, user guides, training materials, partner communication, knowledge transfer and continuous improvement of R2R processes. Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • At least 3+ years of experience working with Oracle ERP Cloud applications, including knowledge of module interactions and integrations with third-party applications.

  • Knowledge of Oracle Finance Cloud, General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Tax. We prefer a working knowledge of Receivables and Payables.

Good to Have

title: Full Stack React Application Developer
tagsAndSkills: analytics platforms,application developer,ai,analytics tools,aws lambda,azure devops,analytics,azure functions
jobDescription:
Job Summary

React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products
  • Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution
  • Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
  • Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API
  • Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
  • Optimize frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
  • Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design Backend Development

  • Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
  • Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
  • Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
  • Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
  • Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
  • Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
  • Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration Data Layer

  • Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
  • Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
  • Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimized APIs
  • Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
  • Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

  • Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document QA and contextual search
  • Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps Delivery

  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

Requirements

Must have skills

  • 57 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
  • Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
  • Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
  • Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and/or MongoDB
  • Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
  • Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
  • Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
  • Experience with Docker containerization and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Good to have skills

  • Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
  • GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
  • Data visualization expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
  • Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
  • Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n)

Education

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

jobDescription:
About Maersk

Maersk is building the next generation of digital capabilities for the global supply chain.

We are re-architecting our platform with a data-first approach - building a trusted, scalable and reusable data foundation for current and future supply-chain use cases.

On top of this foundation, we will build ML models, intelligence, recommendations, GenAI and agentic AI to help customers and teams make better and faster decisions.

A key part of this vision is data democratization - making trusted and contextualised data easy to discover, understand and use across teams, products, models and AI agents.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data, AI/ML, GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer to help design and build this platform from the ground up.

This role combines data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML and architecture. You will build reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions and work closely with engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams and supply-chain experts.

What You Will Do

- Design and build scalable data and AI architecture for data-intensive systems.

- Build trusted data foundations and reusable data products from multiple sources.

- Build reliable batch, streaming and near-real-time data pipelines based on business needs.

- Enable data democratization and self-service access to trusted data.

- Build capabilities for data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, security and observability.

- Establish common business context and semantics so data can be effectively used by applications, ML models, GenAI and AI agents.

- Develop and productionise ML solutions for prediction, forecasting, risk, anomaly detection, recommendations and optimisation

Build production-grade GenAI/LLM solutions using approaches such as RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling.

- Build agentic AI solutions that can reason over trusted data, use tools and APIs, provide recommendations and take actions.

- Design appropriate guardrails, access controls, monitoring and human oversight for AI and agentic solutions.

- Build reusable APIs, services and workflows that connect data, applications and AI capabilities.

- Use platforms such as Pipedream or similar workflow tools where they add value.

- Make architecture and technology decisions considering scalability, reliability, security, performance and cost.

- Establish strong engineering practices including testing, CI/CD and observability.

- Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design and code reviews. - Mentor engineers and help establish engineering and architecture standards

About You

We are looking for someone with strong engineering, data and AI fundamentals who can build production-ready systems.

You should have:

- 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related field.

- Experience designing and building scalable, distributed and data-intensive systems.

- Experience contributing to or owning architecture and technical design for data or AI platforms.

- Strong programming skills in Java and Python. Experience with Scala, Kotlin or similar languages is a plus.

- Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, distributed systems and data processing.

- Experience building data pipelines, data products or data platforms at scale. - Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Databricks, Flink or equivalent.

- Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases

- Good understanding of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage and observability.

- Hands-on experience taking ML models from development to production, including deployment, monitoring and evaluation.

- Experience with GenAI/LLMs and building practical, production-ready applications.

- Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling and LLM evaluation.

- Experience or strong exposure to AI agents and agentic workflows.

- Understanding of AI security, guardrails, access control and human oversight.

- Experience with at least one cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.

- Strong software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD and production operations.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills. - A platform mindset - focused on building reusable capabilities rather than oneoff solutions.

Good to Have

- Experience in logistics, shipping, transportation or supply chain.

- Experience with real-time and event-driven architectures.

- Experience with MLOps and model monitoring.

- Experience with production RAG, AI agents or agent orchestration.

- Experience with MCP or similar agent/tool integration patterns.

- Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic models or entity resolution.

- Experience with Pipedream or similar workflow/integration platforms.

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.

- Experience leading technical design or architecture for large-scale platforms.

Why This Role

This is a greenfield opportunity to help build the foundation for the next generation of supply-chain intelligence at Maersk. Our vision is: Data Foundation Data Products & Context ML & Intelligence Recommendations GenAI Agentic AI The data foundation is the core layer, providing trusted, reusable and contextualised data to products, ML models, GenAI applications and AI agents.

The Senior Associate Information Security Analyst is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for designing and implementing security systems to protect the organization's computer networks from cyber-attacks, and to help set and maintain security standards.

The Senior Associate Information Security Analyst is responsible for assisting in the planning, implementation, and management of information security measures to safeguard the organization's digital assets and systems and contributes to maintaining a secure and compliant environment.
Key responsibilities
  • Monitors security alerts and events from various sources, investigates potential threats, and escalates incidents as necessary.
  • Assists in the implementation and monitoring of security controls, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls.
  • Performs regular vulnerability assessments, analyses scan results, and assists in prioritizing and remediating identified vulnerabilities.
  • Supports the incident response team in investigating security incidents, documenting findings, and participating in remediation efforts.
  • Assists in ensuring compliance with industry standards (for example, GDPR, ISO 27001) by conducting assessments and implementing necessary controls.
  • Installs security measures and operates software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and data encryption programs.
  • Documents security breaches and assess the damage they cause.
  • Works with the security team to perform tests and uncover network vulnerabilities.
  • Fixes detected vulnerabilities to maintain a high-security standard.
  • Develops organizational best practices for IT security.
  • Performs penetration testing and upgrades systems to unable security software.
  • Installs and upgrades antivirus software and tests and evaluates new technology.
  • Assists with the installation of security software and understands information security management.
  • Researches security enhancements and makes recommendations to management.
  • Stays abreast of information technology trends and security standards.
  • Contributes to security awareness initiatives by creating training materials, conducting workshops, and educating employees about best security practices.
  • Maintains accurate records of security incidents, assessments, and actions taken for reporting and audit purposes.
  • Assists in the management and maintenance of security tools, including antivirus software, encryption tools, and security information and event management (SIEM) systems.
  • Participates in risk assessments to identify potential security threats, vulnerabilities, and associated risks to the organization.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, IT, and other teams to ensure security measures are integrated into the organization's processes and projects.
  • Performs any other related task as required.
Requirements

The frontend includes cluster and GPU management, project workspaces, notebooks, experiments, training and inference workflows, pipeline visualisation, live logs and events, browser terminals, model playgrounds, analytics, and administrative surfaces. What youll do
  • Own complex product surfaces. Build and evolve dashboards, resource explorers, workflow editors, experiment views, model-serving interfaces, project workspaces, and administrative consoles used across the Kubogent platform.

  • Own data-dense infrastructure views. Make clusters, nodes, GPUs, workloads, logs, events, quotas, experiments, and deployments understandable even when customers operate at significant scale.
  • Build real-time surfaces. Work with WebSockets, SSE, streaming logs, live status transitions, long-runningoperations, and high-frequency telemetry without compromising responsiveness or rendering performance.

  • Partner directly with backend and platform engineers. Influence API contracts, event models, pagination, filtering, workflow state machines, and product semantics rather than treating APIs as fixed inputs.
  • Keep the product fast. Establish performance budgets, profiling practices, virtualization strategies, bundlediscipline, and rendering patterns for large enterprise datasets.
  • Raise the production bar. Establish E2E coverage, frontend observability, error monitoring, test strategy, andrelease discipline.

What were looking for

  • reconnects, and partial failure.

jobDescription:
Manager - Strategic Partnerships ( Institutional Grants & HNIs) Location: Noida | Travel across India as required Reports to: Director - Strategic Partnerships About Muskaan Dreams We believe where a child is born should never determine how prepared they are for the future. Every day, millions of children walk into government school classrooms with the same curiosity, dreams, and potential as children anywhere else. But as technology and AI rapidly reshape how we learn, work, and solve problems, access to the skills and opportunities needed to thrive remains deeply unequal. We exist to change that. At Muskaan Dreams, our work begins with children and teachers. We spend time in classrooms, listen deeply to teachers, understand the realities of government schools, and design solutions that can work in the real world, not just in pilots. We dont believe lasting change can be created by building parallel systems. We believe in strengthening the public education system itself. That means working alongside teachers, school leaders, district administrations, and state governments so that solutions can be adopted, sustained, and eventually reach millions of children. Over the last decade, this belief has taken us from working with a handful of schools to reaching nearly 1 million children, 5,000+ government schools and 15,000+ teachers across six states. But for us, scale is not simply a number.
  • Scale means a teacher feels more confident in her classroom.
  • It means a child in a government school beginning to see herself as a problem-solver and creator.
  • It means an education system becoming capable of sustaining change long after a programme or funder has exited.
Our ambition is to ensure that children in Indias government schools are not simply consumers of technology, but become confident problem-solvers, critical thinkers, creators, and future-ready citizens.


Our Flagship Initiatives Digital Shaala Digital Shaala transforms government school classrooms into engaging, technology-enabled learning environments. Through enabling existing interactive digital devices, curriculum-aligned digital content, teacher capacity building, and academic mentoring, the programme strengthens Science and Mathematics learning while nurturing students curiosity, confidence, and interest in STEM education and careers. AI-Saksham AI-Saksham prepares students and teachers for an AI-enabled world. Through experiential, classroom-integrated learning, students develop foundational AI literacy, computational thinking, critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices. The programme empowers young people with the skills and confidence needed to thrive in the future while enabling teachers to integrate AI and computational thinking meaningfully into classroom learning. As India prepares millions of young people for an AI-driven economy, we believe government schools must be at the heart of this transformation, not left behind by it. Our Next Chapter Muskaan Dreams is entering a defining phase of growth. Today, we manage an annual budget of approximately 20 crore, supported by leading corporations, foundations, philanthropies, and ecosystem partners. Over the next 2-3 years, we aim to grow this into a 50 crore annual portfolio through a diversified and sustainable fundraising strategy built on long-term institutional partnerships rather than transactional grants. Our larger ambition is to reach and impact 10 million children over the next five years while building one of Indias leading organisations working at the intersection of AI, education, and government system transformation. Achieving this will require more than funding. It will require a coalition of corporations, foundations, philanthropists, governments, technologists, educators, and leaders who share our belief that every child deserves the opportunity to thrive in an AI-enabled future.

About the Role We are looking for a Manager - Strategic Partnerships who can help us build and grow meaningful partnerships with foundations, philanthropies, family offices, institutional donors, and grant-making organisations in India and globally. This is not simply a proposal-writing or grant-management role. You will be expected to identify opportunities, open conversations, build relationships, develop compelling proposals, convert opportunities into partnerships, and nurture those relationships over time. You will own a portfolio of prospective and existing partners and be accountable for moving relationships from: Research Relationship Opportunity Proposal Partnership Stewardship Renewal & Growth Working closely with the Director - Strategic Partnerships, CEO, Program, MEL, Finance, Government Partnerships, and Communications teams, you will help translate our ambitions, evidence, and stories from the ground into partnerships that enable impact at scale. We are looking for someone who is a relationship builder, storyteller, opportunity creator, and partner advocate. What You Will Own 1. Build New Institutional Partnerships | 50% You will proactively identify and cultivate relationships with:
  • Indian and international foundations
  • Philanthropic institutions
  • Family offices
  • Donor collaboratives
  • Bilateral and multilateral agencies
  • Global grant-making organisations
  • Other mission-aligned institutional funders
You will:
  • Research and qualify high-potential funding opportunities.
  • Build a healthy pipeline of prospective partners.
  • Proactively initiate conversations rather than relying only on incoming opportunities.
  • Understand funder priorities, strategies, geographies, grant cycles, and decision-making processes.
  • Build relationships with relevant decision-makers.
  • Identify areas of alignment between partner priorities and Muskaan Dreams programmes.
  • Move qualified opportunities systematically towards partnership.
The expectation is clear: you will not only manage opportunities, you will help create them. 2. Develop Compelling Proposals & Funding Opportunities | 15% Once an opportunity is identified, you will help convert our work into a proposition that a partner can understand, believe in, and support. You will lead:
  • Concept notes
  • Grant proposals and applications
  • Partner presentations
  • Budgets
  • Logical frameworks
  • Theories of Change
  • Implementation plans
  • Due diligence documentation
  • Supporting grant documentation
You will work closely with Program, MEL, Finance, Government Partnerships, and Communications teams to bring together programme design, evidence, budgets, government context, impact data, and stories from the field. 3. Own Partner Relationships & Partner Success | 15% Fundraising does not end when the grant is signed. You will own relationships with a portfolio of existing partners and ensure that their experience with Muskaan Dreams is thoughtful, transparent, responsive, and impact-focused. You will:
  • Build trusted relationships with partner teams and leadership.
  • Ensure timely and high-quality communication.
  • Coordinate reporting and impact updates.
  • Organise review meetings and field visits.
  • Ensure commitments and deliverables are tracked internally.
  • Surface challenges proactively and transparently.
  • Create meaningful opportunities for partners to experience the work.
  • Identify opportunities for renewals and expansion.
  • Bring partner feedback and perspectives into internal conversations.

Our ambition is that partners dont simply fund Muskaan Dreams. They should become champions of the impact we are creating together. 4. Build Strong Partnership Systems & Intelligence | 20% Strong fundraising needs strong systems. You will:
  • Maintain an accurate fundraising pipeline and CRM.
  • Track opportunities, conversations, next actions, and probabilities.
  • Maintain grant calendars and submission deadlines.
  • Build institutional knowledge about funders and previous engagements.
  • Track philanthropic and funding trends.
  • Develop intelligence around emerging thematic and geographic opportunities.
  • Ensure partnership documentation is organised and accessible.
  • Use pipeline data to support fundraising planning and decision-making.
Partner Success Is Central to This Role We believe successful partnerships are built on trust, transparency, shared purpose, and measurable outcomes. We want every partner to feel that:
  • They understand the impact their support is creating.

At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. This role focuses on creating a clean, minimal, and highly interactive single-page experience where users interact primarily through conversation rather than traditional screens. You will work closely with backend, AI, and SDK teams to translate system responses into intuitive, dynamic UI components. The role involves building complex animations, handling multimodal inputs, ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews, and maintaining high code quality suitable for large-scale production systems.
Duties and Responsibilities
Conversational UI Frontend Development Design and build a single-page, conversational UI that replaces traditional multi-screen flows. Develop dynamic, schema-driven UI components that render based on user intent, profile, and system capabilities. Implement fluid animations, transitions, and motion systems while ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews and browsers. Build support for multimodal inputs and outputs including text, voice, image, and file interactions. Ensure UI adapts gracefully across devices, channels (WebView vs browser), and capability constraints. UI Architecture Code Quality Contribute to frontend architecture decisions, component design, and state management patterns. Build reusable, well-structured UI components with clear separation of concerns. Ensure code is clean, maintainable, and easy for other developers to understand and extend. Work closely with backend teams to consume UI schemas, capability flags, and conversational state. Performance, Security Stability Optimize bundle size, rendering performance, and animation smoothness for low-end devices. Implement fallback and degradation strategies for constrained environments. Follow secure frontend practices including CSP compliance, PII masking, and safe handling of user inputs. Support analytics, audit events, and session tracking hooks as required by enterprise standards. Collaboration Delivery Collaborate with AI, backend, SDK, and product teams to translate conversational responses into effective UI. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and iterative UI improvements. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments
Key Decisions / Dimensions
UI Design Implementation Decisions Choosing appropriate UI patterns for conversational and single-task interfaces instead of traditional page-based navigation. Deciding when UI behavior should be driven by backend schemas versus handled locally in the frontend. Selecting animation and motion techniques that balance visual richness with performance constraints. Deciding fallback and degradation strategies for low-end devices, WebView limitations, and browser constraints. Framework Component Decisions Defining reusable UI components and interaction patterns to be used across journeys. Choosing libraries or native implementations for animations, gestures, and multimodal interactions. Deciding how to structure components to keep them extensible and easy to maintain. Ensuring configuration-driven UI is preferred over hardcoded logic wherever possible. Performance, Security Stability Decisions Deciding trade-offs between UI complexity and runtime performance. Implementing safe handling and rendering of user inputs, media, and AI responses. Deciding what data is rendered, masked, or excluded in the UI for compliance and audit needs. Testing UI changes across devices, OS versions, and integration environments before release

Building a highly dynamic, conversational UI that replaces traditional screen-based navigation without confusing users. Delivering fluid, futuristic animations and rich visual effects while maintaining performance inside mobile WebViews and low-end devices. Handling multimodal inputs and outputs reliably across different devices, browsers, and mobile OS versions. Working within strict security, privacy, and compliance constraints while implementing advanced UI interactions. Adapting UI behavior based on user capabilities, channel limitations, and backend-driven schemas. Debugging and optimizing UI issues that span frontend code, WebView behavior, SDK integration, and backend responses. Maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture as UI logic becomes increasingly dynamic and personalized.

Experience building dynamic, single-page, component-based applications. Hands-on experience with animations, transitions, and motion systems. Experience handling multimodal inputs (text, voice, image, file). Familiarity with WebView constraints and cross-browser compatibility. Experience integrating with backend APIs (REST/gRPC). Performance, Security Quality Knowledge of frontend performance optimization and bundle management. Awareness of frontend security practices and safe input handling. Experience integrating analytics, audit events, and logging. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds.

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Kubernetes Platform & Networking
jobDescription:
Who are we

Equinix is the worlds digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriersbecause progress starts with fresh ideas. Youll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes youbecause when you feel valued, youre empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform''s architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.

You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

Responsibilities

OS Provisioning Bare-Metal Infrastructure

  • Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap

  • Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention

  • Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane Worker Nodes

  • Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones

  • Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node

  • Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD Data Plane Deployment

  • Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates

  • Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network

  • Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation

  • Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS Kubernetes Upgrades

  • Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change

  • Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live

  • Apply the platform''s patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane

  • Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes

  • Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call Incident Management

  • Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events

  • Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting

  • Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months

  • Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps

  • Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion

  • Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration

  • OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks

  • etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live

  • Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane

  • Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

Qualifications

Required

  • OS bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening

  • Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement

  • Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management

  • Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling

  • CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet

  • Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it

  • Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet

  • Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage

  • On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response

  • Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

Preferred

  • Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one

  • SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation

  • SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform

  • Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

title: Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
jobDescription:
AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
3-5 Years | Coimbatore/ Bangalore |Full-Time
About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience
  • Prior experience in a customer delivery, consulting, or systems integration role, rather than purely product/platform engineering.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.
  • Own delivery end-to-end. From discovery call to production go-live, you are the engineering owner of the customers voice AI outcome.
  • Build on accelerators that work. Convogent has real production traction - you configure and extend a working platform across diverse customer environments.
  • Direct customer exposure. Work face-to-face with enterprise technical stakeholders, not just internal teams.
  • Backed and proven. AI-native, AWS Preferred Partner, BVP- and Sorin-backed, with 100+ enterprise customers in the first year.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Kuku TV is looking for a Mid-Senior Video Editor (2-5 years) who can turn scripts, performances, live-action footage, and AI-generated visuals into high-retention, binge-worthy micro-dramas. This role is ideal for an editor who understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting footage-it s about hooking viewers, building emotion, escalating conflict, and ending every episode with a reason to watch the next one.

You ll work across live-action + AI-generated content in a fast-paced, high-volume episodic production environment.

Responsibilities

Storytelling Editing

  • Edit live-action and AI-generated micro-dramas for mobile-first audiences.
  • Create powerful opening hooks, emotional peaks, reveals, twists, payoffs, and cliffhangers.
  • Shape dialogue, performances, music, SFX, voiceovers, and visuals into compelling narratives.
  • Select the strongest takes to maximise emotion, conflict, suspense, and character relationships.
  • Maintain strong pacing, visual rhythm, dialogue clarity, narrative progression, and audience retention.
  • Apply principles of information control, escalating conflict, pattern interruption, and retention-driven editing.

Mobile-First Storytelling

  • Edit specifically for vertical 9:16 formats and mobile viewing.
  • Maintain strong composition, visual hierarchy, readable performances, and screen impact.
  • Understand how to optimise storytelling for short attention spans and binge consumption.

AI Video VFX

  • Work confidently with AI-generated characters, environments, performances, and shots.
  • Identify and fix AI-video issues such as facial inconsistencies, lip-sync errors, flickering, warping, unnatural movement, frame instability, and continuity issues.
  • Handle AI-assisted post-production including lip-sync correction, cleanup, upscaling, frame interpolation, shot extension, masking, tracking, compositing, and background replacement.
  • Know when an AI shot can be fixed in post-production and when it needs to be regenerated.

Visual Sound Finishing

  • Seamlessly integrate live-action and AI footage through colour correction, grading, reframing, compositing, motion treatment, and visual matching.
  • Create titles, captions, transitions, motion graphics, VFX, recaps, end cards, and promotional elements when required.
  • Handle dialogue editing, music, ambience, Foley, and SFX to strengthen emotional and dramatic impact.
  • Ensure clear audio balance across mobile devices and viewing environments.

Production Collaboration

  • Maintain story, character, costume, location, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and performance continuity.
  • Manage multiple episodes, revisions, and priorities in a fast-moving production pipeline.
  • Collaborate with directors, writers, creative producers, AI artists, and sound designers.
  • Implement feedback accurately and meet tight delivery timelines.
  • Maintain organised project files, proxies, media libraries, naming conventions, version histories, templates, and archival masters.
  • Perform creative and technical QC and deliver final episodes to required platform, codec, resolution, frame-rate, aspect-ratio, and audio specifications.

What we re looking for

Must Have

  • 2-7 years of professional video-editing experience, preferably in fiction, micro-dramas, web series, films, TV, advertising, digital entertainment, or narrative short-form content.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, dramatic pacing, emotional editing, and technical polish.
  • Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.
  • Advanced Adobe after Effects skills, including compositing, masking, and tracking, cleanup, and motion graphics.
  • Strong knowledge of Gen AI tool - Runaway, ElevanLabs, Kling, Veo, Adobe Firefly, Topaz or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve for colour correction, grading, finishing, and media management.
  • Strong understanding of narrative structure, screen direction, continuity, performance selection, montage, shot progression, and visual rhythm.
  • Experience editing dialogue-driven scenes, romance, emotional sequences, action, confrontations, reveals, and cliffhangers.
  • Strong understanding of audience retention and mobile-first 9:16 storytelling.
  • Experience working with both live-action and AI-generated footage.
  • Strong understanding of sound editing, dialogue balancing, music placement, ambience, Foley, and SFX.
  • Ability to colour-match footage from different cameras, tools, and production pipelines.
  • Strong eye for character, facial, costume, prop, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and background continuity.
  • Ability to manage multiple episodes, revisions, and deadlines in a high-volume production environment.

AI Experience

Experience with generative AI video/image, lip-sync, cleanup, enhancement, upscaling, interpolation, shot extension, and compositing workflows is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluent Hindi and working proficiency in English.
  • Experience with micro-dramas, vertical dramas, episodic fiction, web series, or retention-driven entertainment.
  • Experience in fast-turnaround, high-volume episodic production.
  • Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing, localisation, and multilingual versioning.
  • Knowledge of proxy workflows, shared storage, media relinking, project templates, automated syncing, and structured post-production handoffs.
  • Basic understanding of OTT and digital-platform delivery standards.
  • Film editing, filmmaking, media production, animation, or related degree/diploma is a plus, but not mandatory.

title: Freelance Software Engineer - AI Coding Agent Evaluation
jobDescription:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.
About the Role
You ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.
Responsibilities :
  • Invent a realistic developer scenario - a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature - not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands - deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20-60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors tasks as a QA reviewer.
Not in scope
  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship - you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles - scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships - quality over quantity.
Requirements
  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack - Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency - required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring - reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux Bash - comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience - Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English - B2+ written.
Not a fit
  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.
Preferred qualifications
  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.
Process
Apply Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) Join a project Complete tasks Get paid.
Time commitment
  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2-4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8-20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.
Compensation:
  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour .
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.
Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.
Apply
Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist - Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.
