About the company and the product
India Health Link is building a new multi-tenant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) - one platform serving many hospitals - with Artificial Intelligence (AI) features delivered as optional plug-ins on top of a core that works fully without them. It is a greenfield build, and the first pilot hospital goes live in month 6.

Our stack : Amazon Web Services (AWS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, TypeScript and NestJS services, PostgreSQL 16, Python for the AI services.

What you will build
- The whole AWS footprint as Terraform code : Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Relational Database Service (RDS) PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Simple Storage Service (S3), OpenSearch, Redis, EventBridge and CloudFront.
- Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) on GitHub Actions: build, test, migrate, deploy, roll back. Deployment must be boring.
- Environments : development, staging, pre-production with anonymised data, and production.
- Monitoring and alerting that a twelve-person team can actually respond to, with centralised logs and traces.
- Backup and disaster recovery with a tested restore, not a documented one.
- The on-premise edge gateway image that runs inside a hospitals local network for analyser connectivity and Local Area Network mode when the internet is down.

Responsibilities
- Own infrastructure cost, keep it inside the agreed monthly budget, and report it monthly.
- Own security hygiene: least-privilege identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, patching, and network boundaries.
- Own remediation for the Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Test (VAPT) in month 5 - coordinate the external firm and drive every finding to closure.
- Make the developer experience good. A new engineer should be productive on day two.
- Set up data-residency arrangements appropriate to Indian health data.
- Be the person who can tell, at 2 am, whether the problem is our service, the database, or the hospitals internet connection.

Requirements
- Four or more years on AWS in production, including ECS or equivalent container orchestration, RDS, IAM and VPC networking.
- Terraform written and maintained by you, with proper modules and state management.
- Ownership of a CI/CD pipeline, including the database migration step.
- Observability in practice: you have been on call, and you have tuned alerts that were too noisy.
- Linux and networking fundamentals - you can debug why a device inside a hospital cannot reach a service.

Good to have
- Compliance work: ISO 27001, SOC 2, or Indian health data regulation.
- On-premise or hybrid deployments, and hardware appliances in the field.
- Real cost optimisation on a live bill.
- Experience supporting customers with unreliable connectivity.

Your first 90 days
- Month 1 - all environments live, CI/CD running, the walking skeleton deployed automatically.
- Month 2 - monitoring, alerting and centralised logs in place; backups running with a tested restore.
- Month 3 - the edge gateway image built and running against analyser simulators.

How we work
Two-week sprints. Everything is code - infrastructure included. Code review on every pull request.
Required Skills
GitHub Actions Docker Terraform CI/CD AWS ECS / Fargate Amazon Web Services (AWS) AWS RDS / PostgreSQL AWS IAM

jobDescription:
Full-Stack Developer (AI-Native)


We are hiring a full-stack developer with strong AI engineering skills to own the applications, tools, and digital products we build in-house, end to end.


This is a hands-on ownership role. You will design and build our own web applications, internal tools and AI features, take them from prototype to production, keep them reliable and secure once live, and turn ideas into working products. You will also work alongside our existing engineers on the larger products we are building.


This is a role for someone who works fluently with AI development tools as a core part of how they operate. We expect you to use AI not just to write code faster, but to read and understand systems quickly, reason about technical decisions, and ship AI features with confidence. You also verify what the tools produce: you test it, probe it, and can explain what they got wrong and how you caught it. That fluency is central to the role.


This is a fully remote opportunity, operating in UK timezone.


Working: 5.5 days per week. Monday - Friday: 9am - 6pm UK time. Saturday: 9am - 1:30pm UK time.


The Role


You will:


* Design, build, and ship our own web applications, tools, and digital products end to end, across the full stack (React / Next.js front end, plus Node / TypeScript APIs, PostgreSQL, integrations, and auth).

* Build AI features into real products: LLM integrations, RAG, agents and structured outputs, with validation, fallbacks and evaluation so they hold up in production, not just in a demo.

* Own the back end and data layer of what you build: schema design, migrations, transactions, background jobs, webhooks, and third-party integrations (payments, messaging, email).

* Keep what we ship healthy once it is live: performance, reliability, security, uptime, monitoring, and fixes.

* Read, review and harden code you did not write, including code produced with AI tools, before it reaches production.

* Build high-quality, responsive front ends when the feature needs it, to a solid standard of polish, performance, and accessibility.

* Deploy and run what you build (Vercel, Google Cloud Run, Docker, CI/CD) and keep environments, secrets and pipelines tidy.

* Use AI development tools fluently throughout your work, to build, to understand unfamiliar code quickly, and to move fast without losing rigour.

* Turn early ideas into working prototypes fast, and take the ones that work through to production.


What we're looking for


* 3+ years building full-stack web applications, with a portfolio of live work you can speak to in depth.

* Strong, current full-stack skills: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, APIs, auth, and integrations, with real back-end and data depth.

* Hands-on experience building and running AI features in production: LLM APIs, RAG, agents, prompt and output validation, evaluation, and the failure modes that come with them.

* A solid grasp of what goes wrong in real systems: authorisation on every data path, input validation, idempotency, concurrency, secrets, and logging.

* Demonstrable, fluent use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow, including using them to read and understand unfamiliar codebases quickly, and to check their own output.

* Clear communication and the confidence to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, in writing and in conversation, to technical and non-technical people.

* Comfort working independently in a remote, UK-timezone team and owning delivery end to end.

jobDescription:
About The Role

Project Role :Business Process Architect


Project Role Description :Design business processes, including characteristics and key performance indicators (KPIs), to meet process and functional requirements. Work closely with the Application Architect to create the process blueprint and establish business process requirements to drive out application requirements and metrics. Assist in quality management reviews, ensure all business and design requirements are met. Educate stakeholders to ensure a complete understanding of the designs.
Must have skills :SAP ABAP Development for HANA

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum



15 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native, HANA optimized SAP applications and extensions by combining deep ABAP on HANA engineering with agentic AI patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The role focuses on delivering high performance, cloud ready, production-grade solutions using HANA pushdown principles, modern ABAP, and governed AI capabilities that can reason, retrieve context, and assist or act within enterprise SAP workflowswithout training foundation models from scratch.

Core Responsibilities
1) ABAP on HANA Engineering (Performance First)
Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).
Build efficient data models and access patterns using CDS views, associations, annotations, and authorization concepts.
Implement performance critical logic using AMDP / SQLScript where appropriate, with careful governance and testing.
2) Modern ABAP Development Clean Design
Develop modular, testable, and maintainable ABAP code aligned to clean architecture practices and enterprise SDLC.
Build services and APIs using modern paradigms (OData/service exposure patterns), ensuring stability, versioning, and contract-first behavior.
Apply secure coding standards and authorization checks consistently across data and service layers.
3) Data Modeling, Reporting Semantic Enablement
Model enterprise business entities using CDS semantics to support both transactional and analytical consumption.
Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
Ensure lineage-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.
4) AI Native SAP Capabilities (Agentic + Grounded)
Build AI enabled SAP experiences that integrate ABAP services with LLM capabilities, including:
oTool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
oRetrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
oDeterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low
Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.
5) Quality Engineering Evaluation Loops (AI + ABAP)
Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors:offline golden datasets, scenario-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
Introduce guardrails for AI outputs:authorization-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.
6) Observability, Reliability Operations
Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root-cause analysis.
Design robust error handling for enterprise flows:retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.
7) Integration End to End Delivery
Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
Strong hands on expertise in ABAP Development on HANA (performance tuning, pushdown, efficient SQL access patterns).
Proficiency with CDS views and modern data modeling practices (associations, annotations, authorization concepts).
Experience with AMDP / SQLScript for performance critical scenarios and controlled code pushdown.
Solid software engineering discipline:clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness.
AI native build capability:LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
OData/service design patterns, API lifecycle management, and contract-first development.
Experience integrating SAP backends with cloud runtimes and enterprise integration platforms.
Familiarity with performance benchmarking, load testing, and query-plan driven tuning practices.
Knowledge of SAP security/authorizations and compliance requirements for sensitive enterprise data.

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training or fine tuning foundation models from scratch.
AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.

Value Delivered
High performance SAP solutions through HANA optimized ABAP engineering and disciplined pushdown design.
Faster delivery of intelligent SAP workflows via agentic AI patterns that are grounded, governed, and measurable.
Reduced operational risk through automated testing, observability, and robust safety boundaries for AI-enabled actions.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required
Qualification15 years full time education

Build responsive, user-friendly SAPUI5 interfaces using MVC architecture, component-based patterns, and standard UI5 application structure.

SAP Fiori design paradigm familiarity and ability to translate UX principles into scalable UI solutions.

Understanding of SAPUI5 vs OpenUI5 positioning and implications for enterprise delivery.

Not limited to AI-assisted coding or only using copilots this role builds AI-native UI behaviors and owns their quality (grounding, safety boundaries, evaluation).

Summary
Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and scaling intelligent SAP applications that integrate ABAP Cloud with LLMs, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and enterprise systemsmoving from automation to autonomy.
This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

Core Responsibilities
AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows:tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.
Integrate LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines (RAG) with ABAP Cloud services for contextual, grounded responses.
Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.
Data, Retrieval Context
Build and integrate retrieval pipelines using SAP and non SAP data sources (business objects, CDS views, documents, events).
Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.


Value Delivered
Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.

Summary
Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and scaling intelligent SAP applications that integrate ABAP Cloud with LLMs, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and enterprise systemsmoving from automation to autonomy.
This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

Core Responsibilities
AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows:tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.
Integrate LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines (RAG) with ABAP Cloud services for contextual, grounded responses.
Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.

About The Role  

Entity:- Accenture Strategy Consulting

Team:- Strategy Consulting Global Network

Practice:- Marketing Analytics

Title:- Consultant/ Manager/Analyst Marketing Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI)

Job location:- Any out of 6 AI locations

About SC - Global Network (GN) :- Accenture GNs Data AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling to outperform the competition.

WHATS IN IT FOR YOU

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

What you would do in this role

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.



Key Duties and Responsibilities:(GCP CDP)
  • Architect Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
  • Model for Insight Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.
  • Champion DevOps MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager.
  • Deploy Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms.
  • Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference.
  • Collaborate Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering.
  • Ensure Governance Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically.


    • Key Duties and Responsibilities:(RTCDP)
  • Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage
  • Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc.
  • Provide deep domain expertise in our clients business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry
  • Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
  • Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc.
  • Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer
  • Assess and audit the current state of a clients marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements
  • Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution
  • Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client.
  • Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation.
  • Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the clients needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools.
  • Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations.
  • Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration
  • Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
  • Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing
  • Perform technical analysis design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard.


    • Key Duties and Responsibilities:(Agentic AI)
  • Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP.
  • Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities.
  • Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making.
  • Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents.
  • Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources.
  • Leverage Gemini models'' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem-solving in marketing contexts.
  • Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents.
  • Implement and leverage grounding evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications.
  • Develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini.
  • Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components.
  • Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access.
  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems.
  • Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques.
  • Create insights presentations and client-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations.
  • Mentor and guide junior resources, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
  • Demonstrate strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively convey complex concepts and insights to stakeholders.
  • Develop strong relationships with clients at all levels, understanding their specific challenges and opportunities.

The focus is to move beyond dashboards into intelligent data experiencesdata agents, conversational analytics, and grounded insightsbuilt on governed Datasphere models and integrated enterprise sources.
SAP Datasphere is positioned as a data warehousing solution with integration capabilities.
Core Responsibilities
1) AI Native Data Product Engineering (on Datasphere)
Design and implement governed data products using Datasphere concepts such as Spaces and shareable models/views, enabling teams to explore, transform, and share curated datasets across domains.
Build semantic models that are fit for both analytics and AI consumption (clear entity definitions, measures, hierarchies, lineage-friendly design).
2) Retrieval + Grounding (RAG) over Enterprise Data
Create grounded AI experiences by connecting LLM applications to Datasphere s curated models and enterprise sources (SAP and non SAP), ensuring responses are traceable to governed data.
Engineer retrieval strategies that respect domain boundaries (spaces), freshness needs, and access controls, so AI outputs remain reliable and compliant.
3) Hybrid Modernization Migration (BW bridge patterns)
Enable transition paths from legacy warehouse investments by leveraging approaches such as reusing SAP BW models and skills with Datasphere / BW bridge, supporting phased cloud modernization.
4) Lakehouse style Layering Data Quality by Design
Implement layered design patterns (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) to land raw data, cleanse/validate, and publish analytics ready modelswhile maintaining clear rules for what s exposed for consumption.
Embed quality controls, validation checks, and reproducible transformations as part of the delivery lifecycle.
5) Agentic Orchestration Tooling
Build data agents that can plan, call tools (query/metadata/lineage), retrieve context, and generate answers with citationsbacked by deterministic checks and fallback behaviors.
Implement prompt templates, tool schemas, and safe action boundaries for enterprise-grade usage.
6) Evaluation, Observability Responsible AI
Establish offline/online evaluation loops (golden questions, regression suites, behavior tests) for conversational analytics and data agents.
Add telemetry for AI interactions (latency, grounding rate, failure modes) to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
7) Integration Collaboration
Partner closely with business, data governance, and platform teams to align data products with real decisions and operational workflows.
Drive reusable patterns and accelerators for repeatable delivery across domains.

SAP BTP Datasphere:data modeling, spaces, sharing patterns, enterprise semantic design.
Strong data warehousing fundamentals and ability to translate business domains into governed analytical models.
Hands-on building with LLMs + RAG (retrieval, grounding, prompt/tool design, evaluation).
Solid software engineering fundamentals:testability, CI/CD mindset, reliable integrations.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills

Layered architecture implementation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for scalable analytics delivery.
Familiarity with vector search / embedding pipelines (when integrating external AI retrieval components).

Training foundation models from scratch (the emphasis is on building agentic apps and governed retrieval on enterprise data).
AI assisted only delivery this role owns the AI behavior (grounding, evaluation, safety) end to end.

Faster path from data to decision through conversational + agentic analytics grounded in governed Datasphere models.
Scalable modernization of hybrid data estates via patterns like BW bridge.
Higher trust AI outputs by implementing layered quality + evaluation loops.

title: Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
jobDescription:
AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
3-5 Years | Coimbatore/ Bangalore |Full-Time
About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience
  • Prior experience in a customer delivery, consulting, or systems integration role, rather than purely product/platform engineering.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.
  • Own delivery end-to-end. From discovery call to production go-live, you are the engineering owner of the customers voice AI outcome.
  • Build on accelerators that work. Convogent has real production traction - you configure and extend a working platform across diverse customer environments.
  • Direct customer exposure. Work face-to-face with enterprise technical stakeholders, not just internal teams.
  • Backed and proven. AI-native, AWS Preferred Partner, BVP- and Sorin-backed, with 100+ enterprise customers in the first year.

title: Associate Business Development Manager
tagsAndSkills: Co-sell,International Sales,Microsoft Partner Ecosystem,Solution Sales,Data & AI Sales,Strategic Alliances,Proposal Writing,Microsoft Sales
jobDescription:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Associate Client Engagement Manager works alongside the senior Client Engagement Manager to drive Celebal's commercial and client engagement activity across the GCC primarily Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with a clear path to owning accounts and transactions outright.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, but it is not a coordination role. You will be expected to hold your own in a first conversation with a Microsoft solution specialist or a client stakeholder without a technical colleague on the call, to explain what Celebal does differently in a specific solution area, and to build and defend a commercial estimate. Pre-sales, delivery and practice teams support you; they do not substitute for you.

Read this before applying: the interview includes a live technical and commercial assessment. Candidates who position themselves as functional or relationship-only sellers, and who require pre-sales support for every solution conversation, are not a fit for this role — regardless of years of experience or account pedigree.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Pipeline Ownership & Deal Progression

  • Own and progress a defined slice of the GCC opportunity pipeline — from qualification through proposal submission, negotiation support and closure — with the senior CEM as escalation point rather than as approver of every step.
  • Run RFP, RFI and tender responses end to end: interpret requirements, decompose the scope, own the response plan and timeline, drive contributions from pre-sales and practice leads, and assemble a submission that is compliant and commercially sound.
  • Manage Microsoft and partner co-sell motions directly — deal registration, co-sell submissions, MCI/ECIF and pre-sales funding nominations, and joint account planning with Microsoft SSPs, ATUs and partner leads (Crayon and others).
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy and pipeline reporting to a standard that leadership can act on without rework.
  • Schedule and lead client meetings, demos and technical presentations; author the meeting narrative and the follow-up MOM, not just the logistics.

2. Client Engagement & Account Ownership

  • Act as a named point of contact for assigned accounts, holding day-to-day commercial and delivery-liaison conversations independently.
  • Produce client-facing material — proposals, BoQ and BoM summaries, executive briefings, project status narratives — in a form that goes to the client with light review, not heavy rewriting.
  • Track milestone status with delivery, trigger milestone-linked commercial actions, and own invoicing follow-up, collections escalation and revenue realisation for your accounts.
  • Maintain complete, auditable engagement documentation: MSAs, SOWs, Change Requests, LOIs, correspondence and approval trails.

3. Solution Positioning & Differentiation

  • Articulate what Celebal does differently in specific solution areas — Microsoft Fabric and Databricks-based data platform modernisation, migration accelerators, GenAI and agentic use cases, sovereign cloud and security — and why that beats an incumbent system integrator. This is a core competency of the role, not a marketing hand-off.
  • Maintain and actively use the GCC solution narrative: capability decks, reference architectures, case studies, industry-specific use-case libraries and competitive positioning.
  • Translate a client problem statement into an indicative solution shape and commercial envelope in the room, then validate it with pre-sales — rather than deferring the entire conversation.

4. Proposal, Estimation & Commercial Construction

  • Author the executive summary, scope of work, assumptions, exclusions and commercial sections of proposals; source tech stack, effort estimates and delivery timelines from pre-sales and delivery and integrate them coherently.
  • Build and adjust Azure consumption estimates independently using the Azure pricing calculator — storage, compute, capacity SKUs and licensing — and understand how those choices move the client's total cost.
  • Draft quotations, SOW summaries and Change Request documentation; understand the difference between T&M, fixed-price, managed-capacity and outcome-based structures and when each is appropriate.

5. Internal Coordination & Governance

  • Liaise with delivery, legal, finance and HR on engagement onboarding, commercial issue resolution and contract execution.
  • Prepare internal briefing notes, commercial summaries, deal review packs and escalation memos of a standard suitable for regional leadership review.
  • Contribute to WBS updates, revenue forecasting and weekly/monthly business reviews.
  • Ensure clean account handovers with full context and documentation captured.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Essential — screened against, no exceptions

  • GCC market experience. 4–6 years in B2B technology sales, client engagement, pre-sales or account management, including demonstrable UAE and/or KSA market experience — in-market work history, or documented ownership of GCC-based client relationships. Regional exposure gained purely through remote channel coordination does not meet this requirement.
  • Microsoft partner ecosystem depth. Hands-on experience with co-sell motions, deal registration, and pre-sales or partner funding mechanisms (MCI, ECIF or equivalent), including working relationships with Microsoft field roles (SSP, ATU, partner development).
  • Data & AI portfolio literacy. Working knowledge of the Microsoft data and AI stack — Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, GenAI/Copilot patterns — sufficient to scope a data platform, migration or AI use-case conversation unaided.
  • Cloud and security fundamentals. Practical fluency in Azure architecture basics, M365/O365, and Microsoft security and compliance (Sentinel, Defender, identity). Certification at fundamentals level or above (AZ-900, MS-900, SC-900, DP-900 or higher) is expected; equivalent demonstrated knowledge is acceptable.
  • Estimation capability. Able to build and defend an Azure consumption estimate on the Azure pricing calculator without pre-sales assistance. This is tested live during interview.
  • RFP and tender ownership. Direct experience running or substantially owning RFP, RFI or government tender responses, including compliance and commercial sections.
  • Services-commercial exposure. Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs and Change Requests, and with authoring scope and commercial terms for services engagements — as distinct from licensing or product resale.
  • Deal scale. Experience on engagements where individual proof-of-concept values reach USD 150K or above and multi-year programmes exceed USD 1M. Celebal proof-of-concept engagements alone routinely run USD 200K–250K.
  • Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling deliberately in the sales craft — research, account intelligence, first-draft proposal and RFP response construction, competitive analysis — with judgement about what must still be authored and verified by a human.
  • Communication. Clear, professional written and spoken English; able to produce client-ready correspondence and documents with minimal supervision.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA or a technical postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • Mobility. Based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, with a valid ability to travel across KSA and the GCC.

Preferred

  • Arabic language capability.
  • Prior employment with a Microsoft partner, system integrator or technology consulting firm serving enterprise clients in the region.
  • Account experience in logistics, government or public sector, FMCG, or financial services in the GCC.
  • Exposure to sovereign cloud, data residency or regional compliance requirements (SDAIA, NDMO, UAE data protection).
  • Experience with CRM and revenue tooling — Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clari.
  • Familiarity with government procurement portals and tender platforms in KSA or the UAE.

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical credibility. Can hold a solution conversation with an architect or Microsoft specialist and be taken seriously. This is the single most important competency in the role.
  • Commercial judgement. Understands deal structures, pricing models, margin implications and revenue recognition well enough to shape a deal, not just document it.
  • Independent ownership. Moves an opportunity forward without waiting to be told the next step; escalates with a recommendation attached.
  • Competitive framing. Can explain why Celebal, in a specific solution area, against a specific incumbent, in under two minutes.
  • Organisational rigour. Manages concurrent engagements with accurate documentation, clean CRM and reliable follow-through.
  • Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable across pre-sales, delivery, legal and finance internally, and across client procurement, IT and business stakeholders externally.
  • Cross-cultural effectiveness. Operates credibly in GCC business culture and with distributed India-based delivery teams.
  • Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth regional business with evolving priorities.

SELECTION PROCESS

Candidates should expect a structured assessment rather than a conversational interview. The process comprises an HR screening, a technical and commercial round with sales leadership, and a regional fit discussion.

What we assess


How

Solution positioning


You will be asked to pitch Celebal cold to a Microsoft SSP covering a named industry, and to answer why a client should move work to us from an incumbent SI. Generic value statements do not clear this stage.

Commercial sizing


You will be asked to open the Azure pricing calculator on screen and build or adjust a simple estimate — storage, compute, capacity SKU — without pre-sales support.

Solution depth


You will be asked to walk through the most technically complex engagement you have sold, including data sources, integration approach and platform choices, in your own words.

Commercial structure


You will be asked how a proposal is assembled — which sections you author, which you source from pre-sales and delivery, and how pricing model and timelines are arrived at.


CAREER PATH

This role is a structured route into a full Client Engagement Manager position. Candidates who demonstrate technical credibility, commercial judgement and independent account ownership will be considered for progression within 18–24 months. Progression is assessed on independent deal ownership and solution credibility, not tenure.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
  • Direct exposure to marquee enterprise and government accounts across the GCC.
  • Close collaboration with Microsoft field and product teams, including global initiative and sovereign cloud programmes.
  • Structured mentorship from experienced regional sales leadership.
  • Funded certification pathways across Azure, Data & AI, and Security.
  • Fast-track growth in a priority geography, within a global team spanning the Americas, EMEA, India, APJ, Australia and Japan.

To apply or for queries, please contact: chaity.mukherjee@celebaltech.com

About Maersk

Maersk is building the next generation of digital capabilities for the global supply chain.

On top of this foundation, we will build ML models, intelligence, recommendations, GenAI and agentic AI to help customers and teams make better and faster decisions.

A key part of this vision is data democratization - making trusted and contextualised data easy to discover, understand and use across teams, products, models and AI agents.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data, AI/ML, GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer to help design and build this platform from the ground up.

This role combines data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML and architecture. You will build reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions and work closely with engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams and supply-chain experts.

What You Will Do

- Enable data democratization and self-service access to trusted data.

- Use platforms such as Pipedream or similar workflow tools where they add value.

- Make architecture and technology decisions considering scalability, reliability, security, performance and cost.

- Establish strong engineering practices including testing, CI/CD and observability.

- Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design and code reviews. - Mentor engineers and help establish engineering and architecture standards

We are looking for someone with strong engineering, data and AI fundamentals who can build production-ready systems.

You should have:

- 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related field.

- Experience designing and building scalable, distributed and data-intensive systems.

- Strong programming skills in Java and Python. Experience with Scala, Kotlin or similar languages is a plus.

- Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, distributed systems and data processing.

The goal is to build a platform where new data and AI capabilities can be developed faster, reused across multiple use cases and scaled across the supply chain without repeatedly rebuilding the underlying foundation. jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer will design, develop, support, and continuously enhance digital solutions across Lilly's global manufacturing network, while serving as the owner for one or more digital products developed by the DME team. Representative solutions in scope span the four pillars of the Engineering Digital Strategy and include - but are not limited to - the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, RCA and troubleshooting solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, capital project and qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, and inspection-readiness data products. These solutions are developed on standard Digital Engineering Platforms supported by the DME team, and the engineer will partner with data leads to ensure the necessary IT, OT, and ET data is available to support each solution. The engineer is also expected to leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropics Claude - to accelerate development and to embed AI capability into solutions, including building agent skills, prompt-based workflows, and retrieval/automation patterns on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms. This role is not focused on training or developing foundation models; it is focused on applying AI tools effectively and responsibly to manufacturing problems. This is a global role, supporting functional initiatives and all Lilly Manufacturing sites globally.

Role Context / Operating Model

This role operates within an evolved Digital Solutions Engineering operating model. The team includes a Rapid Innovation branch that works at speed to prototype concepts and proof-of-value solutions against key business problems surfaced from the manufacturing network. The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer takes ownership of those solutions once they have been validated as worth scaling - maturing them from prototype to production-grade, hardening them for validated-system and data-integrity requirements, deploying and supporting them across sites, and providing long-term ownership over their roadmap, enhancement, and lifecycle. This split lets the Rapid Innovation branch stay focused on speed and discovery while the Principal Digital Solutions Engineer ensures that the most valuable concepts become durable, well-supported solutions that scale across the global manufacturing network.

Primary Focus

The primary focus of the role is twofold. First, to develop and continuously enhance high-quality digital solutions that deliver measurable value to manufacturing operations - improving productivity, data integrity and compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Second, to assume the role of owner for those solutions: defining the product roadmap, managing the backlog, owning the technical architecture and lifecycle, ensuring compliance with validated-system requirements, and providing direct technical support to global users across Lilly Manufacturing. The engineer will work under guidance of the Digital Program Lead and partner closely with site engineers, network engineering organizations, and IT/OT platform owners to ensure each solution remains fit-for-purpose as the network and the underlying technology landscape evolve.

Key Objectives / Deliverables

  • Develop and continuously enhance digital solutions in support of the Engineering Digital Strategy for Manufacturing and Quality across its four pillars: Asset Delivery Qualification, Asset Performance/Maintenance Reliability, Engineering Fundamentals, and Training Knowledge Management.
  • Build and own solutions across a broad portfolio that may include: the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, RCA and troubleshooting tools, capital project and equipment qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, change-management assistants, and inspection-readiness data products.
  • Serve as owner for one or more DME-developed digital products, including ownership of the product roadmap, backlog, technical architecture, and full lifecycle from build through sustained operation.
  • Partner with the Rapid Innovation branch of the Digital Solutions Engineering team to take in validated prototypes and proof-of-value solutions, then mature them into production-grade, validated, scalable solutions ready for global deployment.
  • Lead the deployment of solutions across Lilly Manufacturing sites - including site onboarding, configuration, change management, training, and stand-up of ongoing support.
  • Provide direct technical support for owned solutions across the global manufacturing network - triaging issues, performing root cause analysis, delivering fixes, and managing the change and release process to keep solutions reliable and validated.
  • Drive continuous enhancement of solutions in production, prioritizing improvements based on user feedback, operational data, evolving site needs, and emerging technology capabilities.
  • Leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropics Claude - to accelerate solution development, automate routine engineering tasks, and embed AI capability into DME solutions. This includes building agent skills, prompts, retrieval-augmented patterns, and automated workflows on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms; it does not include training or developing foundation models.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and patterns and integrate them responsibly into DME solutions, in alignment with Lillys AI governance, data integrity, and validated-system requirements.
  • Write, review, and maintain production-quality Python code that powers DME digital solutions; establish and uphold development standards, code review practices, and version control discipline.
  • Build analytics, monitoring, and visualization capabilities using Seeq and Power BI to surface manufacturing insights to engineers, operators, and leadership.
  • Partner with data leads within DME to define and provide the IT, OT, and ET data requirements needed to support each solution, and ensure data flows are reliable, governed, and fit-for-purpose.
  • Ensure all solutions are designed, operated, and enhanced in accordance with validated-system, data-integrity, and GMP requirements, and develop and implement the associated technical requirements and documentation.
  • Develop proof-of-concept solutions to explore new concepts within the Engineering Digital Strategy and progress them toward production

title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Summary
It's not just about your career or job title. It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you're in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.
Role Summary/Purpose
The Wabtec Data Analytics (DA) team is driving the company's next-generation data and analytics ecosystem with a strong focus on Data Democratization, Self-Service, and AI-led innovation. We are seeking a Data Scientist with strong SQL expertise and experience across data engineering, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Science to enable scalable, governed, and intelligent self-service solutions.
In addition to building and curating trusted datasets, this role will contribute to the development of AI-powered solutions leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Denodo AI SDK, Dataiku, and Agentic AI frameworks to enhance data discovery, analytics, automation, and business decision-making. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting advanced analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and Generative AI solutions that accelerate business value and operational efficiency.
The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent development, and advanced analytics, enabling business users to effectively leverage data and AI capabilities through trusted, self-service platforms and intelligent automation solutions.
Essential Responsibilities
As a Data scientist, you will be responsible for the following:
  • Partner with DA leadership and business stakeholders to evolve and execute the Data Self-Service and Data Democratization strategy.
  • Work directly with functional users to understand self-service data needs across data discovery, reporting, analytics, and advanced use cases.
  • Design, build, and curate high-quality datasets to support analytics and reporting use cases, including development of curation tables.
  • Strong experience in SQL and PL/SQL
  • Create and maintain data documentation, user guides, and standards in SharePoint to promote adoption and consistent usage.
  • Develop and publish logical and physical data models and ER diagrams to support self-service and semantic layers.
  • Collaborate with architecture and emerging technology teams on proof-of-concept evaluations of new data, analytics, and AI platforms.
  • Help assess whether self-service tools are being used correctly, and guide users toward the most effective tools for their use cases.
  • Contribute to self-service design patterns, implementation standards, and roadmaps based on business usage patterns.
  • Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance.
  • Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data.
  • Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Perform in-depth data analysis, data modeling, and data design activities to support business and analytics needs.
Qualifications/Requirements
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in self-service and analytics platforms including Denodo, Dataiku and Power BI.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms (Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock) for designing and developing intelligent agents and workflow automation.
  • Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • Hands-on experience or internships in data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, business-oriented terms.
  • Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics principles, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and semantic layer design.
  • Basic exposure to advanced analytics concepts such as predictive analytics, data mining, or statistical analysis is a plus.
  • Understanding data storage and processing technologies including relational databases, columnar databases, Hadoop or Hive-based platforms.
  • Strong experience in data modeling concepts and tools such as ERwin or ER Studio.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with technologies such as Spark, HiveSQL, Python, R, Sqoop, and JDBC or ODBC connectivity.
  • Understanding data visualization best practices and storytelling through dashboards and reports.
Desired Characteristics
  • Experience working on IT or data projects in collaborative, cross-functional teams.
  • Exposure to information systems design, implementation, or operational support.
  • Familiarity with application development or data platform development concepts.
  • Experience or exposure to data technologies such as Hive, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Hadoop, or NoSQL platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data cataloging, or data lineage tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and cloud data strategies is a plus.
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and customer-focused approach.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with clear and structured communication.
  • Ability to anticipate challenges and proactively develop mitigation plans.
  • Change-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset and openness to new ways of working.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to learn new tools and technologies quickly.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with attention to detail and standards.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • High ethical standards and commitment to integrity and accountability.

Prompting is engineering here, not trial and error. You will own the prompt and evaluation layer of real AI products: agents, retrieval pipelines and in-product copilots that run against live traffic. This role is primarily focused on physical threat intelligence, while remaining aligned with the broader threat intelligence mandate.
  • The Physical Threat Intelligence Analyst is responsible for proactively identifying, monitoring, analysing, and assessing physical security threats that could affect the organisation s people, assets, operations, reputation, and overall resilience. The role requires systematic collection and evaluation of intelligence from a broad range of sources, including open-source reporting, vendor intelligence, professional networks, and internal stakeholders. By monitoring global, regional, and local risk developments, the analyst produces timely, actionable, and clearly articulated threat assessments that support security operations, executive decision-making, crisis management, incident response, and business continuity planning. This position plays a critical role in helping the organisation anticipate emerging risks, understand their potential business impact, and implement appropriate mitigation measures in a dynamic threat environment.
  • This is an emerging leadership role suited to a candidate with prior experience managing intelligence analysts, developing team capability, and delivering time-sensitive intelligence products in support of Regional Intelligence Analysts across Deutsche Bank.
  • In addition to producing high-quality analysis, the candidate will lead the Information Processing & Research team (IPR), an internal team formed within the Threat Intelligence function. The IPR team transforms structured and unstructured data from multiple sources into high-quality intelligence, enabling data-driven threat identification and informed decision-making through robust collection and validation processes. The team partners with regional analysts through an intelligence-led approach to deliver actionable insights and identify key threat drivers, trends, and patterns across relevant areas of focus.

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves

Hello, We are Hiring Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships at Link Publishers Pvt. Ltd

Experience: 3 5 Years
Department: Sales & Partnerships
Location: Ahmedabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships who can identify and build partnerships with SEO products, SaaS platforms, agencies, and other digital marketing businesses.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify companies where the Link Publishers API can be integrated into their existing product or where our platform can be offered as a white-label link-building solution under the partners own brand.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on mass cold outreach. We are looking for someone who can research a product, understand how it works, identify where Link Publishers fits into its ecosystem, and then approach the right decision-maker with a personalized partnership proposition.

Key Responsibilities 1. Identify API Partnership Opportunities

Research and identify SEO tools, SaaS products, marketing platforms, backlink tools, content platforms, AI SEO tools, agency software, and other relevant products where the Link Publishers API can add value.

You will be expected to:

1/ Understand what the target product does and who its customers are.
2/ Explore the product, website, features, pricing, and existing integrations.
3/ Identify where link-building capabilities can fit naturally into the product.
4/ Develop a clear use case for integrating the Link Publishers API.
5/ Identify the right companies based on partnership potential rather than simply building large prospect lists.

For example, if an SEO platform helps users identify backlink opportunities but doesnt provide a way to actually purchase or execute those placements, you should be able to identify how Link Publishers can potentially fill that gap through an API integration.

2. Build White-Label Partnerships

Identify companies that want to offer link-building services to their customers without building their own publisher network or fulfillment infrastructure.

The goal is to position Link Publishers as their backend link-building partner while they continue selling the service under their own brand name.

Potential partners may include:

1/ SEO agencies
2/ Digital marketing agencies
3/ SaaS companies
4/ SEO platforms
5/ Content marketing platforms
6/ Reseller businesses
7/ Enterprise SEO service providers

You will understand their existing business model and propose a white-label partnership that makes commercial sense for both companies.

3. CXO & Decision-Maker Outreach

Identify and connect with relevant decision-makers, including:

Founders, Co-Founders, CEOs, CMOs, Heads of SEO, Heads of Partnerships, Product Heads, Business Heads, and other senior stakeholders.

The role requires thoughtful outreach rather than sending generic templates.

Before contacting a prospect, you should understand:

What does their company do Where can Link Publishers fit What value can we add Who is the right person to approach What should the partnership proposal look like

4. Personalized Email Outreach

Strong email writing is one of the most important requirements for this position.

You should be able to research a product and write a personalized email explaining exactly how an API integration or white-label partnership could benefit their business.

We are not looking for generic emails such as:

"We provide link-building services and would love to explore a partnership."

Instead, outreach should demonstrate that you have understood the prospects product and identified a genuine integration opportunity.

Emails should be concise, personalized, commercially relevant, and written to generate conversations with senior decision-makers.

5. Partnership Discussions & Closure

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the partnership conversation from initial discussion to closure.

This includes:

1/ Understanding the partners requirements
2/ Conducting discovery calls
3/ Presenting relevant API/white-label solutions
4/ Coordinating product demonstrations
5/ Discussing commercial models
6/ Coordinating technical discussions with internal teams
7/ Following up with stakeholders
8/ Managing NDA/documentation requirements
9/ Moving opportunities toward integration and launch

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how APIs work from a business and product perspective.

What Were Looking For

Experience: 3 5 years in Partnerships, Business Development, SaaS Sales, Strategic Alliances, API Partnerships, SEO SaaS, or a similar role.

The ideal candidate should have:

1/ Strong understanding of SaaS products and online business models.
2/ Good understanding of SEO and link building.
3/ Ability to research and understand new products independently.
4/ Ability to identify API integration opportunities.
5/ Experience communicating with founders and CXO-level stakeholders.
6/ Excellent written English and email communication.
7/ Strong personalization and cold outreach skills.
8/ Ability to convert product research into a compelling partnership proposition.
9/ Confidence conducting discovery and partnership calls.
10/ Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.
11/ Commercial mindset and ability to think beyond traditional sales.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to code for this role.

However, you should understand basic concepts such as:

API integrations, SaaS platforms, data exchange, product integrations, white-label solutions, marketplaces, and reseller models.

You should be able to communicate a potential integration use case clearly enough for product and technical teams to take the discussion forward.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of emails sent.

We will primarily look at the quality and business impact of partnerships generated, including:

Relevant companies identified Decision-makers contacted Qualified partnership conversations API/White-label opportunities Commercial discussions Signed partnerships Successful integrations

The objective is to build long-term distribution and technology partnerships that allow Link Publishers inventory and link-building capabilities to reach customers through other products and brands.

About Link Publishers

Link Publishers is a link-building marketplace that connects businesses, agencies, and SEO professionals with publishers across multiple industries and markets.

Through our API and white-label solutions, partners can integrate link-building capabilities into their own products or offer link-building services under their own brand while Link Publishers supports the inventory and fulfillment from the backend.

We are looking for someone who can identify where these partnerships make sense and turn those opportunities into scalable business relationships.

jobDescription:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.
