jobDescription:
About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Own the design and delivery of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority client-facing materials.
  • Translate strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear visual narratives, page structures, diagrams and data stories.
  • Develop credible visual options based on the audience, content maturity, client context and available time.
  • Manage multiple assignments independently, clarify briefs with business stakeholders and flag scope, timing or quality risks early.
  • Apply and reinforce Inizio Ignite brand standards, templates, accessibility requirements and final-file standards.
  • Provide constructive craft feedback and practical support to Designer 1 colleagues, while escalating priority creative decisions to the Senior Designer.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through creative review or independent QA.
  • Create and refine reusable templates, slide components, visual systems, iconography and data-visualisation patterns.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, correctly named and version-controlled files that support reliable handover and future reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate understanding, exploration and production, while ensuring every output is accurate, appropriate and human-reviewed.
  • Contribute to studio standards, onboarding materials, knowledge capture and continuous improvement.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 4+ years of experience in presentation design, visual design, production design or a related creative role, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, consulting, professional services or an agency environment.
  • A strong portfolio showing polished client-facing presentation work, visual storytelling, slide redesign, data visualisation and alternative creative approaches.
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or similar tools; charting experience would be advantageous.
  • Strong command of layout, typography, hierarchy, information design, brand application and final-file quality.
  • Ability to work directly with stakeholders, challenge unclear briefs constructively and manage expectations across several concurrent requests.
  • Experience giving useful craft feedback or supporting the development of less-experienced designers.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to evaluate AI-assisted outputs critically and responsibly.
  • High attention to detail, strong prioritisation and confidence working under time pressure without compromising core quality standards.
  • Ideal profile
  • You can move comfortably between fast-turn production work and more considered visual storytelling.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and know when to involve the Senior Designer or business stakeholder.
  • You enjoy helping others improve and contributing to shared standards, assets and ways of working.
  • You are motivated by the opportunity to shape a new Design Studio and strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

title: Lead Generation : Definition & Meaning
tagsAndSkills: conversion optimization,brand building,cold calling,back office,ai,business development,advertising,brand strategy
jobDescription:
Lead generation is the systematic process of identifying and attracting potential customers who demonstrate interest in a company's products or services.

What Is Lead Generation

Marketing teams, sales professionals, and business development specialists use lead generation to build sustainable revenue pipelines, reduce customer acquisition costs, and achieve predictable growth targets through systematic prospect identification and engagement processes.

What Are The Primary Lead Generation Methods Used By Marketing Teams

Marketing teams implement 8 primary lead generation methods to attract and capture qualified prospects. These lead generation approaches are listed below:

  • Content marketing: Organizations create valuable blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, and educational resources to attract prospects searching for industry solutions and expertise
  • Search engine optimization: Marketing teams optimize website content and landing pages to rank higher in search results for keywords that potential customers use during research phases
  • Pay-per-click advertising: Companies run targeted ads on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other platforms to capture leads actively searching for specific products or services
  • Email marketing campaigns: Organizations send targeted email sequences to newsletter subscribers, webinar attendees, and content downloaders to nurture relationships and generate sales opportunities
  • Webinars and events: Companies host virtual and in-person events, trade shows, conferences, and educational sessions to demonstrate expertise and collect contact information from attendees
  • Referral programs: Businesses incentivize existing customers, partners, and industry contacts to recommend qualified prospects through structured referral systems and reward programs
  • Cold outreach: Sales development representatives contact potential customers through phone calls, LinkedIn messages, and personalized emails based on targeted prospect lists and research

What Are the Types of Lead Generation

Lead generation encompasses 6 primary types that businesses use to attract and capture potential customers. These lead generation approaches are listed below based on their channel characteristics and targeting methods.

  • Content marketing, SEO, social media Attracting prospects through valuable content
  • Cold calling, email campaigns, direct mail Proactively reaching out to potential customers
  • PPC advertising, social ads, display campaigns Capturing leads through online advertising
  • Event-Based Lead Generation Trade shows, webinars, conferences Generating leads through direct engagement
  • Customer referrals, partner networks Leveraging existing relationships for new leads
  • Account-Based Lead Generation Targeted campaigns, personalized outreach Focusing on specific high-value accounts

What Are the Key Components of Lead Generation Systems

Effective lead generation systems contain 5 essential components that work together to identify, capture, and nurture potential customers throughout the sales funnel.

  • Lead Magnets Valuable content offers like whitepapers, ebooks, webinars, or free trials that attract prospects and encourage contact information sharing.
  • Landing Pages Dedicated web pages designed to convert visitors into leads through compelling copy, clear value propositions, and optimized conversion forms.
  • Lead Capture Forms Data collection mechanisms that gather prospect information including name, email, company, and qualifying questions to assess lead quality.
  • Lead Scoring Systems Automated frameworks that assign point values to leads based on demographics, behavior, and engagement level to prioritize sales follow-up.
  • Lead Nurturing Workflows Automated email sequences and content delivery systems that educate prospects and maintain engagement until they reach sales-ready status.

What Is Lead Generation Formula

Lead Conversion Rate Formula

Lead Conversion Rate = (Number of Converted Leads Total Number of Leads) 100

This formula measures how effectively leads progress through the sales funnel, with each variable representing critical performance indicators:

  • Number of Converted Leads represents prospects who completed the desired action, such as making a purchase, signing a contract, or scheduling a consultation within the measurement period.
  • Total Number of Leads includes all qualified prospects who entered the sales funnel during the same timeframe, regardless of their final conversion status.
  • Conversion Rate Percentage indicates the efficiency of the lead nurturing process, with industry benchmarks ranging from 2-5% for most B2B sectors and 1-3% for B2C markets.

Sample Lead Generation Calculation

A software company generates 500 leads through digital marketing campaigns and converts 25 leads into paying customers during Q1.

Step 1: Identify converted leads = 25 customers

Step 2: Identify total leads = 500 prospects

Step 3: Apply formula = (25 500) 100

Step 4: Calculate result = 0.05 100 = 5%

The 5% conversion rate indicates above-average performance for B2B software sales, suggesting effective lead qualification and nurturing processes that convert 1 in every 20 prospects.

Important Considerations

Lead quality varies significantly across acquisition channels, making total volume metrics misleading without segmentation by source, qualification criteria, and conversion timeframes. Track conversion rates separately for each marketing channel to identify the most cost-effective lead generation strategies.

What Are Lead Generation Related Terms

Lead generation intersects with 7 distinct business development concepts that professionals often confuse or misapply. These related terms represent different stages, approaches, and outcomes within customer acquisition strategies.

Key Distinction from Lead Generation Creates market awareness and interest before capturing leads Brand building and market education campaigns Evaluates and scores existing leads for sales readiness Sales process optimization and resource allocation Develops relationships with existing leads over time Marketing automation and customer journey management Complete process from initial contact to paying customer Strategic planning and performance measurement Researches and identifies potential customers before contact Outbound sales strategy and target market analysis Improves rates at which visitors become leads or customers Digital marketing and website performance improvement Tracks and manages entire customer journey from awareness to purchase Sales operations and revenue forecasting

Lead Generation vs. Demand Generation

Lead generation captures contact information from prospects who already show interest, while demand generation creates that initial interest through market education and brand awareness campaigns. Demand generation precedes lead generation in the customer acquisition timeline.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Qualification

Lead generation focuses on quantity by attracting and capturing prospect information, while lead qualification emphasizes quality by evaluating which leads possess genuine purchase intent and budget authority. Qualification follows generation in sales processes.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Nurturing

Lead generation obtains initial prospect contact information through single interactions, while lead nurturing develops ongoing relationships with those prospects through sequential communications over weeks or months until they reach purchase readiness.

Lead Generation vs. Customer Acquisition

Lead generation represents one component within customer acquisition by providing potential buyer contact information, while customer acquisition encompasses the complete journey from initial awareness through final purchase and onboarding activities.

Lead Generation vs. Prospect Development

Lead generation uses inbound methods to attract prospects who voluntarily provide contact information, while prospect development employs outbound research to identify and contact potential customers who have not yet expressed direct interest.

Lead Generation vs. Conversion Optimization

Lead generation creates systems and campaigns to attract potential customers, while conversion optimization analyzes and improves the performance of existing lead generation assets to increase response rates and contact capture efficiency.

Lead Generation vs. Sales Funnel Management

Lead generation feeds prospects into the top of sales funnels through specific acquisition activities, while sales funnel management oversees the entire pipeline from initial contact through closed deals, including lead generation as one input component.

What Are the Core Distinctions Between These Terms

5 fundamental differences separate lead generation from related customer acquisition concepts across timing, scope, and measurement criteria.

  • Timeline Position: Lead generation occurs at specific points in customer journeys, while demand generation happens earlier and customer acquisition spans the entire process from awareness to purchase.
  • Success Metrics: Lead generation measures contact capture.

jobDescription:
ABOUT UA/UNIFORM ADVANTAGE BRANDS

For over 40 years, UA Brands has designed fashion-forward apparel for the medical and culinary professionals who make a difference every day. We re proud to support the people behind the work, those showing up and making an impact every shift. We re a purpose-driven team with a strong commitment to community, collaboration, and service. Here, you ll find a culture that values connection, fresh perspectives, and real impact. From the start, we re committed to giving you an authentic look at life at UA Brands and how you can grow, contribute, and make your mark.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role follows a permanent work schedule of 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST, Monday through Friday.

We are looking for an applied AI and automation engineer to build and ship practical tools that make UA s operations faster and more reliable. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role: the person takes problems and priorities defined by leadership and turns them into working software AI agents, automations, scripts, and integrations that connect our systems and remove manual work. Success is measured by what ships and the results it produces, not by research or strategy. A core part of the job is technical judgment: knowing when a problem genuinely needs AI versus when a simpler, reliable rule-based tool is the right answer, and building accordingly.

Initial work centers on UA s AI and automation roadmap: building and deploying managed AI agents for operations use cases such as order and return exception handling and inbound document processing, automating manual B2B and customer-service workflows, and integrating these solutions with existing systems including Dynamics AX, Zoom Contact Center, and Microsoft 365. The role works under the direction of the Project Manager and partners with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope and deliver.

WHAT YOU LL DO

  • Build, test, and deploy AI agents and automations for prioritized operations use cases (e.g., order and return exception handling; inbound document processing against Dynamics AX).
  • Build deterministic automation tools and scripts where business logic is rule-based (e.g., conditional product removal, dormant account review), reserving AI for inputs that are genuinely unstructured.
  • Collaborate with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope, validate, and prioritize automation opportunities.
  • Document builds, configurations, and runbooks, and support handoff to operations and other teams.
  • Evaluate vendor and platform AI capabilities to inform build-versus-buy decisions and avoid duplicating features already on a vendor roadmap.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between AI/automation solutions and existing systems (Dynamics AX 2012 R3 via SFTP, Zoom Contact Center, Microsoft 365).
  • Automate manual operations and workflows (e.g., Pardot form and order entry, alerting and escalation routing).
  • Test, monitor, and report on the accuracy, performance, and ROI of deployed AI and automation solutions; flag and resolve failures.
  • Maintain, debug, and improve tools already running in production.
  • Translate leadership objectives and business requirements into technical specifications and working prototypes.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (or an equivalent programming language) for developing automations, scripts, and system integrations.
  • Sound judgment to determine when a problem is best addressed using AI versus deterministic or rule-based solutions.
  • Strong experience in debugging, testing, deploying, and monitoring production-grade solutions.
  • Proficiency in API and data integration, including file-based exchanges, SFTP, and integrations with legacy applications and ERP systems.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and tool/function calling.
  • Highly self-directed, with the ability to consistently deliver high-quality outcomes with minimal supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and structured data management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Software Engineer II
jobDescription:
Software Engineer II

POSITION PURPOSE:

We are hiring a hands-on Backend Engineer to build, operate, and own the microservices that power FarmRise a platform that puts agronomic advice directly into the hands of smallholder farmers. This is not a role where you hand off deployment and operations to someone else: you will design the service, write the code, own the AWS infrastructure it runs on, and be the first call when it breaks in production.

You will work across services spanning user onboarding, agronomy, commodity pricing, news/events, and third-party integrations. We are looking for someone who treats a production incident or an ambiguous requirement as their problem to solve, not someone waiting to be assigned a ticket.

What You Will Own End to End

  • Service design architecture: design and evolve Java + Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs consumed by the FarmRise mobile app and internal platforms; make and document trade-offs on data modeling, service boundaries, and API contracts.
  • Cloud infrastructure (AWS): own the full runtime your services live on ECS/Fargate for compute, RDS/Aurora Postgres for persistence, S3 for storage, CloudWatch/CloudTrail for logs and audit, SNS/AmazonMQ for messaging, CloudFront for delivery, ElastiCache for caching plus IAM, VPC/networking, and secrets management. You provision, tune, and troubleshoot this infrastructure yourself, not through a separate DevOps team.
  • Async event-driven systems: design event/queue-based workflows on RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) producers, consumers, retry and dead-letter handling, idempotency, and back-pressure for resilient, decoupled processing.
  • Data layer: design Postgres schemas, indexes, and queries for correctness and performance at scale; own migrations and query optimization as data volume grows.
  • Observability reliability: instrument services with structured logging and metrics (Datadog/CloudWatch), define SLOs, set up alerting, and drive scalability, availability, and fault-tolerance practices across the platform.
  • CI/CD quality: maintain build and release pipelines (GitHub Actions, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, JUnit); keep test coverage, code quality gates, and deployment safety nets healthy.
  • Security: apply JWT-based auth patterns and platform security conventions; treat data privacy and secure coding as a default, not an afterthought.

What You Will Do Day to Day

  • Ship backend features and services against explicit expectations for reliability, latency, and cost not just it works on my machine.
  • Deploy and operate services on AWS, including scaling decisions, cost tuning, and incident response when something breaks in production.
  • Debug production issues end-to-end using logs, metrics, and traces and own the fix, not just the diagnosis.
  • Build and evolve shared libraries, interceptors, and API standards that improve developer experience across the platform.
  • Use AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) deliberately to speed up code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation while following secure coding and data privacy practices.
  • Partner directly with product, mobile, and platform teams to turn ambiguous requirements into scoped, reliable services and push back when a request is not the right build.
  • Review code from other engineers with a focus on quality, performance, security, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE:

Required:

  • 4 10 years of backend engineering experience building and operating production services not just writing code that others deploy.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design, with real production systems you can walk through in depth.
  • Proven, hands-on AWS experience: you have personally deployed, scaled, and debugged services on ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, S3, and CloudWatch including IAM and VPC/networking troubleshooting. You do not need someone else to touch the AWS console for you.
  • Solid grounding in microservices patterns service boundaries, contract design, versioning, and scaling services independently.
  • Practical, past experience with Postgres: schema design, indexing, and query optimization on production workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with messaging/async systems, especially RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) including retries, dead-letter queues, and idempotent consumers.
  • Practical CI/CD experience: Git-based workflows, build tooling (Maven/Gradle), code quality gates (SonarQube), and unit testing (JUnit) as a default practice, not an exception.
  • Strong, independent debugging skills across logs, metrics, and distributed systems you can own a production issue from alert to resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation, applied with secure coding and data privacy discipline.
  • Ownership mindset: a demonstrated track record of taking a problem statement, scoping it, and driving it to production without needing constant direction.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with JWT auth flows and API gateway/routing patterns.
  • Experience with caching strategies and HTTP caching concepts (ETags, max-age headers).
  • Exposure to serverless patterns (Lambda), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and additional data stores (Redis/NoSQL).
  • Experience operating services with centralized logging/monitoring stacks (Datadog, CloudWatch).
  • Prior experience in Agri-tech, agri-inputs, rural commerce, or similar domains serving high-scale, low-connectivity users.

title: Project Leader
jobDescription:
Position Summary
Design, configure, operate and optimize Databricks and cloud platform capabilities for Commercial Pharma data workloads from Vizag. The role ensures secure, reliable, cost-effective and scalable platform operations across environments, access controls, CI/CD, monitoring, performance and platform automation.


Business / Program Context
The role is part of a Vizag-based delivery capability supporting Commercial Pharma datasets across global markets. The work may include platform operations, data engineering, data quality, reporting, AI enablement, release governance and stakeholder support for enterprise commercial data products. The role is not limited to Japan-specific datasets; Japan market familiarity may be useful but is not a mandatory baseline requirement for most positions.


Job Responsibilities
  • Manage Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, workflows, notebooks, repos and platform configurations.
  • Support Unity Catalog, access controls, credential management, workspace permissions and audit readiness.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion, release automation and platform deployment standards.
  • Monitor cluster performance, job failures, usage patterns, costs and capacity.
  • Support cloud storage, networking, secrets, identity integration and environment provisioning activities.
  • Create reusable platform templates, automation scripts, monitoring alerts and operational runbooks.
  • Partner with Data Engineers and QA teams to resolve environment, performance, deployment and access issues.
  • Work as part of a Vizag-based delivery team supporting Commercial Pharma datasets and global commercial data stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with business, technology, governance, quality and offshore/onshore delivery teams across time zones.
  • Follow Agile delivery, SDLC, documentation, release, validation, access-control and data-governance standards.
  • Contribute to knowledge management, reusable assets, SOPs, runbooks and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Maintain strong communication discipline, including status updates, risk identification, issue escalation and timely stakeholder follow-through.


Required Work Experience
  • 4-8 years of relevant experience aligned to the role and seniority level.
  • Prior experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare analytics, commercial data platforms or enterprise data programs.
  • Experience working in a global delivery model with structured governance, documentation, SLAs and stakeholder communication.
  • Ability to work from Vizag and collaborate effectively with India, global and client teams.


Technical / Functional Skills
  • Databricks administration
  • Unity Catalog
  • Azure/AWS platform services
  • CI/CD and DevOps
  • Terraform or infrastructure automation
  • Git and release pipelines
  • Monitoring and cost optimization
  • Security and access management


Commercial Pharma Dataset Exposure
  • Pharmaceutical commercial data platforms
  • Sales, prescription, claims, CRM and omnichannel datasets
  • Customer master, HCP/HCO, product master, territory and alignment datasets
  • Commercial KPIs, field force effectiveness, market share and promotional effectiveness
  • Data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata and controlled release processes


Desirable Skills
  • Experience supporting global pharma companies or commercial data programs.
  • Exposure to Eisai-like commercial operating models, field reporting, sales operations and analytics use cases.
  • Japan market dataset exposure is preferred but not mandatory unless the assignment requires direct Japan business engagement.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain data, risks, defects and business impact clearly.
  • Certifications in Databricks, Informatica IDMC, Azure/AWS, Scrum, ITIL, Tableau/Power BI or AI/ML are preferred depending on role.


Success Measures / KPIs
  • Secure and stable platform, optimized cost/performance, reliable deployments and reduced environment-related incidents.


Indicative 30 / 60 / 90 Day Expectations
  1. First 30 days: complete onboarding, understand commercial data landscape, delivery processes, documentation standards and role-specific tools.
  2. First 60 days: independently contribute to assigned workstreams, support issue resolution, produce required artifacts and participate in governance forums.
  3. First 90 days: demonstrate measurable ownership, improve delivery quality, identify improvement opportunities and support stable operations or project outcomes.

jobDescription:
body">
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you ll feel right at home here.
Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.
You will work across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka , supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.
You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.
What You ll Own Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration
  • Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.
  • Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.
  • Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL .
  • Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.
Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations
  • Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.
  • Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.
  • Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore .
  • Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.
  • Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.
Kafka Streaming Infrastructure
  • Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.
  • Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.
  • Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.
  • Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).
  • Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.
  • Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.
What You Bring
  • 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale , preferably in cloud-managed environments.
  • Strong experience with Elasticsearch , including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes .
  • Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform - Azure, AWS, or GCP - with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.
  • Strong understanding of database reliability principles including high availability, disaster recovery, backups, replication, capacity planning, and observability.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming using Python, Go, or a similar language .
  • Experience automating repetitive operational tasks and building self-service infrastructure.
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident-management skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed-system failures.
Good to Have
  • Experience with Kafka and fdb-kubernetes-operator .
  • Experience with Elastic Cloud and ECK .
Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus.
  • Experience managing PostgreSQL through Kubernetes operators or custom resources.
  • Experience with Kubernetes operators and building automation for stateful workloads.
  • Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments .
  • Experience with observability platforms and database performance monitoring.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, data replication, consistency, and failure-domain design.
What Success Looks Like
  • Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.
  • Operational toil across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka is significantly reduced.
  • Database platforms can scale reliably with business and customer growth.
  • Incidents are detected early and resolved through strong automation and observability.
  • Database infrastructure is consistent and resilient across Azure, AWS, GCP, and private-cloud environments.
  • Engineering teams can consume reliable database infrastructure without requiring significant manual DBRE intervention.
Why This Role
This is an opportunity to work on large-scale, distributed data infrastructure at the heart of a modern Knowledge Graph platform. You will have significant ownership across three critical database technologies and will play a key role in making our data infrastructure more automated, reliable, and scalable.

Job Summary

Loyalty Juggernaut is seeking a Product Manager to identify, validate, launch, and scale new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled offerings. We design and run loyalty and customer-engagement programs for some of the world's most recognized brands. Growth doesn't only come from the platform - it comes from new offerings - new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled practices that clients need before anyone has packaged them. This role finds such opportunities and turns them into real businesses.

As a Product Manager in the Loyalty Performance Management (LPM) team, you will own the full lifecycle - from an initial idea or market signal through research, business case, offer design, pilot, commercialization, and practice development. After launch, you will act as the business owner for the incubated practice - setting its roadmap, sharpening the proposition and delivery model, watching commercial performance, and building the repeatability it needs to become a standalone unit.

This is not a traditional software product management role. It blends market strategy, services design, product marketing, commercial ownership, and venture incubation. You are as comfortable building a market landscape and modeling unit economics as you are shaping a client-ready offer, creating sales enablement, and leading cross-functional execution.

Responsibilities

Opportunity discovery & market validation

  • Build and manage a pipeline of new-service ideas.
  • Conduct structured market, customer, category, and competitor research.
  • Define the ideal customer profile, economic buyer, priority use cases, customer pain points and desired outcomes.
  • Lead interviews and working sessions with clients, prospects, sales, delivery teams, product leaders, subject-matter experts, and partners.

Business case, pricing & investment recommendation

  • Build decision-grade business cases that connect market opportunity, strategic fit, client value, investment requirements, risks, and expected business impact.
  • Define pricing, packaging, contract structure, and monetization options - fixed fees, subscriptions, usage or outcome-based fees, revenue share, and hybrid models.
  • Translate assumptions into an executive recommendation and a clear investment ask; track actual performance against the approved case and update the forecast as evidence improves.

Service product design & productization

  • Turn a validated opportunity into a repeatable, sellable offer with a defined customer, outcome, scope, deliverables, methodology, timeline, dependencies, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design the end-to-end service blueprint: client journey, discovery and design activities, delivery workflows, roles and RACI, governance, data and technology requirements, quality controls, SLAs, and KPI framework.
  • Translate service requirements into a prioritized roadmap for platform, data, analytics, automation, and internal tooling in partnership with product and engineering.

GTM & sales enablement

  • Partner with Marketing to define the name, positioning, value proposition, audience, messaging architecture, launch plan, and campaign strategy.
  • Create client-ready sales materials: offering decks, one-pagers, vertical use cases, executive narratives, case studies, ROI tools, proposal content, demo stories, objection handling, and competitive battlecards.
  • Translate complex capabilities into clear stories that connect the customer requirement, the service or solution design, the commercial logic, and the measurable outcome.

Launch, roadmap & practice incubation

  • Own cross-functional launch readiness: milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, enablement, delivery capacity, operational controls, measurement, and executive reporting.
  • Maintain the post-launch roadmap and prioritized backlog across proposition, methodology, commercial model, sales enablement, delivery operations, technology, analytics, and partner ecosystem.
  • Create the operating cadence for the practice: performance dashboards, pipeline and delivery reviews, roadmap decisions, client feedback loops, and quarterly business reviews.

Graduation to a standalone unit

  • Prepare the scale plan: market focus, product and service roadmap, P&L and forecast, organization design, hiring profile, partner model, governance, and investment needs.
  • Transition the practice to its permanent leader with clear ownership, documented IP and processes, an active roadmap, trained teams, customer and pipeline context, and a complete performance baseline.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in services product management, consulting offer development, strategy, professional services, product marketing, corporate innovation, venture building, or a closely related role.
  • Demonstrated success taking at least one B2B service, solution, or practice from concept through launch and into measurable commercial growth.
  • Direct experience building business cases and financial models used to inform real investment decisions - not academic exercises.
  • Experience presenting solutions and recommendations to senior client and internal stakeholders, including executives.
  • Strong market research and customer discovery skills, with the ability to turn incomplete signals into a structured point of view and testable hypotheses.
  • Commercial and financial fluency - business-case development, pricing and packaging, scenario modeling, unit economics, margin, forecasting, and investment recommendations.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together; theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. Its used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.

Where youll leave your mark

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. Youll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. Youll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didnt know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.

Beyond those two, there are surfaces youll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, well expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.

The kind of builder were looking for -

  • Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. Well want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.

  • An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. Were more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.

  • Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.

  • 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.

  • Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters its the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters its carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.

  • Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. Were hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we cant yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.

  • Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since were remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Were proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

title: Tech Enabled Designer
jobDescription:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Role Overview

Within the CTO organization, the Tech-enabled Designer plays a key role in accelerating innovation by transforming concepts into tangible, testable experiences.

Working at the intersection of design, technology, and innovation, the role focuses on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and exploration of emerging interactions (notably AI-driven experiences), enabling teams to quickly validate ideas and demonstrate value.

The Tech-enabled Designer contributes to bridging the gap between design intent and technical feasibility, supporting innovation teams in building compelling and credible Proofs of Concept (POCs).

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Prototyping & Experimentation

  • Design and develop interactive prototypes (Figma advanced prototyping, coded prototypes, AI-driven experiences)
  • Create realistic POCs and demos to support concept validation and stakeholder engagement
  • Explore new interaction paradigms (AI, conversational interfaces, agent-based experiences)

Technology Exploration & Integration

  • Continuously assess and experiment with emerging technologies (Generative AI, prototyping tools, automation)
  • Identify and demonstrate relevant use cases aligned with innovation initiatives
  • Contribute to defining new interaction patterns for future products and services

Design-Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with innovation engineers and technical teams
  • Contribute to feasibility discussions and propose viable alternatives

Acceleration of Validation Cycles

  • Enable rapid testing with users and stakeholders through tangible artifacts
  • Support innovation projects with high-impact deliverables for:
    • internal decision-making
    • executive presentations (CTO / Business Lines)
    • co-innovation workshops

Profile & Qualifications

Education

B.Design and M.Design

Experience

  • 4-6 years of experience in UX design, interaction design, or digital product design
  • Proven experience in prototyping beyond static design (interactive, coded, or experimental)

Skills

Design & UX

  • Strong UX and interaction design capabilities
  • Ability to design complex user flows and systems
  • Experience with service-oriented or system-level thinking is a plus

Prototyping & Technology

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (interactive prototyping)
  • Familiarity with code-based prototyping
  • Experience with AI tools is highly valued

Collaboration & Mindset

  • Strong collaboration skills with international teams (France / USA / Singapore)
  • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (design, engineering, product)
  • Ability to operate in uncertain and exploratory environments
  • Proactive, curious, and experimentation-driven mindset
  • Strong communication and storytelling abilities
  • Experience in conducting design workshops and Interactive sessions

Key Interfaces

  • Innovation Engineers (R&T, CTO teams)
  • Strategic Designers (value proposition, framing)
  • Service & UX Designers (experience design)
  • Product & Business stakeholders

Deliverables

  • Interactive prototypes (Figma and/or coded)
  • Innovation POCs (including AI-driven concepts)
  • Value Proposition artifacts
  • Demonstrators for internal and external stakeholders
  • Experimental interaction models and design patterns

Why Join Us

You will be part of a Strategic Design team within the CTO organization, working on cutting-edge innovation topics (AI, emerging technologies, future user experiences).

This position offers a unique opportunity to:

  • shape future products and services upstream
  • work directly with innovation and engineering experts
  • experiment with emerging technologies in a highly creative environment
  • have visible impact on strategic decisions

At Thales, we re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

jobDescription:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.
Dolby is looking for a talented Senior Foundational Audio AI Researcher to join Dolby s research efforts to drive innovation for audio, signal processing, perception, and application of AI in the audio domain. You will drive key innovations for Dolby s core business which allow Dolby and its customers to build products that push the boundaries of sound and multimedia experiences.
You will focus on the creation and implementation of audio and multimedia signal processing technologies from the underlying theoretical concepts to the development of prototypes and demonstrators, with the goal to create new experiences, and explore new horizons in the fields of audio and multimedia signal processing and AI based generation/processing/ synthesis.
What you will do:
You will push the boundaries of the state-of-the-art in audio, video, and multi-modal technologies. The ideal candidate would have a strong background in deep learning, both in terms of conceptual understanding, as well as practical experience. A core aspect of this role involves being able to keep up to date with the literature, implement, and innovate with the bleeding edge in generative models, self-supervised learning, and multi-modal learning. With the explosion of audio, video, and multi-modal foundational models, you will partner closely with Dolby s worldwide AI research staff, which actively pursues the integration of such models into audio and media experiences. You will be able to hit the ground running, innovate, and contribute to such projects. Consequently, experience with language models, question answering, vision-language models, captioning, etc. would be highly beneficial.

Consequently, knowledge or experience in any/all of the following are helpful:
  • Diffusion, autoregressive, or other generative models.
  • Self-supervised, contrastive learning, auto-encoders.
  • Audio, image, or text applications Source separation, text-to-speech, music synthesis, image segmentation, image captioning, question answering, language models, etc.
Main Responsibilities:
  • Partner closely with other domain experts to refine and execute Dolby s technical strategy in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
  • Use deep learning to create new solutions (including foundation models) and enhance existing applications.
  • Push the state-of-the-art and develop intellectual property.
  • Transfer technology to product groups and draft patent applications.
  • Advise internal leaders on recent deep learning advancements in the industry and academia to further influence research direction and business decisions.
Requirements:

  • A strong background in deep learning, both in terms of conceptual understanding, as well as practical experience.
  • Knowledge in audio, video, or text processing is desirable.
  • Strong publication record, with publications in major machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML). Publications in top domain-specific conferences is desirable (e.g., ACL, CVPR, ICASSP)

  • Highly skilled in Python and one or more popular deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
  • Ability to envision new technologies and turn them into innovative products. Creativity.

Responsibilities

  • Bridge Technical Functional Needs: Translate business requirements into robust system configurations, smart forms, approval workflows, and custom fields.
  • Build Integrations Workflows: Design and maintain Coupa API integrations and middleware connections (MuleSoft, Boomi, SnapLogic) with enterprise ERPs.
  • Develop Custom Analytics: Leverage Coupa Advanced Reporting, Insights, and SQL querying to deliver actionable procurement and financial data reports.
  • Manage Platform Issues: Troubleshoot system bugs, analyze API logs, and partner with Coupa Support to ensure seamless system performance.
  • Streamline Supplier Operations: Oversee Supplier Enablement workflows and manage configurations within the Coupa Supplier Portal.
  • Enhance System Capabilities: Design, test, and deploy platform enhancements, custom reports, and automated process improvements.
  • Engage Stakeholders: Collaborate closely with cross-functional business teams, technical leads, and vendors to streamline procurement operations.

Who You Are

You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you're open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Coupa Techno-Functional Consultant across core P2P, S2P, and contract lifecycle management processes.
  • Specialized Coupa Expertise: Strong proficiency in Coupa Risk Assess (CRA), Spend Guard, Smart Forms, Approvals, and the overall Coupa Data Model.
  • API Middleware Integration: Proven track record with Coupa API integrations, middleware tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, SnapLogic), and major ERP systems (D365 FO, Oracle Cloud).
  • Advanced Reporting SQL: Expertise in Coupa Advanced Reporting, Insights, BI tools, and complex SQL querying for procurement data analysis.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to debug Coupa API logs, resolve technical issues, and partner with Coupa Support.
  • Supplier Workflows: Hands-on experience managing the Coupa Supplier Portal and Supplier Enablement workflows.
  • Process Automation: Familiarity with RPA tools for procurement process automation.
  • Certifications Soft Skills: Strong stakeholder management skills, with Coupa Platform Administration or Technical Integration certification preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with D365 FO, Oracle Cloud Procurement alongside Coupa.
  • Knowledge of RPA (Robotic Process Automation) tools for process automation within Coupa.
  • Experience in Coupa Risk Assess, Spend Guard, and Risk Assessments.
  • Certification in Coupa Platform Administration or Technical Integration.
